abilities.name: Quantum Magic
abilities.text: Launch quantum energy to deal damage

abilities.name: Karmic Revival
abilities.text: Take to the skies, entering a flying state and swiftly surge forward

abilities.name: Soul Bond
abilities.text: Forge a soul bond with allies, granting Healing Over Time and distributing damage taken across the bond

abilities.name: Avatar Life Stream
abilities.text: Target an ally for a bouncing stream of healing energy, which also heals himself upon casting; self-targets if no ally is selected

abilities.name: Cosmic Cluster
abilities.text: Gather quantum energy into a cluster and then swiftly launch it at the enemy

abilities.name: Regenerative Cocoon
abilities.text: Once his body perishes, Adam Warlock can freely move as a soul and reforge his body at a chosen spot

abilities.name: HEAVENLY HARMONY
abilities.text: Storm channels her elemental power into Adam Warlock. When Adam uses Soaring Surge, his movement speed is increased. While flying, Adam leaves behind a storm-charged trail that heals and speeds up allies within it

abilities.name: COSMIC CYCLONE
abilities.text: Base Effect: Teammates linked by Soul Bond receive a Speed Boost. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, linked teammates additionally gain a Damage Boost.

abilities.name: FLAWLESS DESIGN
abilities.text: Base Effect: Cosmic Cluster now provides healing to allies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Ultron, Cosmic Cluster creates an explosion upon impact.

abilities.name: Spear of Ichors
abilities.text: Lunge forward with your spear, dealing damage that increases with Attack Charge. At full charge, Spear of Ichor can launch up enemies

abilities.name: Axes Of Ichors
abilities.text: Alternate powerful strikes forward with twin axes, dealing increased damage as Attack Charge grows. The fourth strike propels you forward in a swift dash

abilities.name: SHIELDED STANCE
abilities.text: Transform Ichors into a shield, gaining Attack Charge when absorbing damage

abilities.name: Seraphic Soar
abilities.text: Glide freely through the air. Continuous flight builds Attack Charge

abilities.name: Divine Judgement
abilities.text: Dive downward, switch to twin axes and infuse the ground with Ichors to create a Divine Judgement Zone upon impact. Within the zone, gain enhanced Speed and attacks grant Bonus Health to self and nearby allies

abilities.name: Wingblade Ascent
abilities.text: Take to the skies, switching back to Spear of Ichors

abilities.name: Assassin's Charge
abilities.text: Enter an accelerated dash state, enemies struck head-on are carried through the air for a short distance

abilities.name: Heven's Retribution
abilities.text: Wrap your spear in ribbons and hurl it with force. Upon impact, the ribbons bind nearby enemies. Angela can leap to the spear's location, damaging surrounding enemies and creating a Divine Judgement Zone

abilities.name: Celestial Command
abilities.text: Angela shares fragments of her Ichors with Thor, empowering him to hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor can leap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range

abilities.name: ASGARDIANS OF THE GALAXY
abilities.text: Base Effect: Activation grants Reveal within a targeted area. Activating the ability again performs a slam attack; enemies hit by the slam are Grounded. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, Angela gains Bonus Health scaling with the number of enemies struck by the slam.

abilities.name: ODIN'S UNACKNOWLEDGED
abilities.text: Base Effect: Project an Illusion forward. The illusion utilizes Assassin's Charge to thrust at enemies. Enemies struck head-on will be carried through the air for a short while. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Loki, the ability gains two charges.

abilities.name: FELINE FURY
abilities.text: Swipe forward with razor-sharp claws

abilities.name: CALLING CARD
abilities.text: Issue a Calling Card to all enemies. Instantly dash to any enemy in sight and range, tearing into them with your claws to deal Damage

abilities.name: CAT'S CRADLE
abilities.text: Lunge forward with claws bared, slicing through any enemies caught in your path

abilities.name: TURN OF FORTUNE
abilities.text: Launch a grappling hook forward that damages an enemy on impact and steals Fortunebefore pulling it back to Black Cat

abilities.name: FORTUNE'S FAVOR
abilities.text: Spend Fortuneto unleash either Grapple Swipeor Phantom Pursuit

abilities.name: STEALTHY CATWALK
abilities.text: Hold {Jump} to crawl up vertical surfaces

abilities.name: MALKIN MISFORTUNE
abilities.text: Apply Jinxto enemies on hit. Jinxedfoes have a chance to lose their bonus damage when striking Black Cat with a Critical Hit

abilities.name: GIFT OF GOLD
abilities.text: Black Cat shares items acquired from Insider Trading with White Fox and Captain America. White Fox receives the Life Orb, which restores Spirit Fox Tail energy and converts life energy into Nine-Tailed Radiance that auto-tracks nearby allies and enemies, granting allies speed and healing while dealing damage and slowing enemies. Captain America receives the Vibranium Energy Amplifier, which expands shield block range when raised and reflects projectiles back along the crosshair direction.

abilities.name: CLAW WHIP
abilities.text: Fire out tethered claws and whip them forward in a devastating arc, dealing damage to all enemies caught in range

abilities.name: PHANTOM PURSUIT
abilities.text: Swiftly dash to an enemy, unleash a rapid flurry of claw attacks, and flash back to your starting position.

abilities.name: GILDED DEAL
abilities.text: Use the Spatial Resonator to open a portal to the Elder Gods' dimension, consuming Fortune to trade with the Golden Elder and acquire items from the New York Thieves Guild vault.

abilities.name: TABLET OF DESTINIES
abilities.text: Gain a random amount of Fortune

abilities.name: HELM OF HADES
abilities.text: Enter Invisiblestate for a set duration

abilities.name: FALTINE FLAME ORB
abilities.text: Conjure an orb of mystical Faltine Flame to Revealand mark all nearby enemies

abilities.name: CHERNOBOG'S CRYSTAL
abilities.text: Purify yourself, instantly removing any active control effects

abilities.name: RING OF ZONA
abilities.text: Open a portal on a surface, allowing instant traversal to the opposite side

abilities.name: MENTO-FISH
abilities.text: Create a hypnosis field. Inflicts Slow, disables movement abilities, and Groundsall enemies caught within

abilities.name: STICKY PAWS
abilities.text: Steal a set amount of Fortunewhenever your attacks hit an enemy

abilities.name: FELINE ALLIANCE
abilities.text: Base Effect: Taking damage accumulates Vibranium Energy. Upon reaching a specific threshold, Black Cat can unleash a violent explosion, damaging and Knocking back surrounding enemies while gaining a brief Speed Boost and Bonus Health. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Panther, this explosion is no longer restricted by the energy threshold and can be triggered at any time.

abilities.name: BINDING TIES
abilities.text: Base Effect: Turn of Fortune is replaced by Spider-Web Grapple, which has 2 charges. Landing the grapple on an enemy steals Fortune and applies a Spider-Tracer. If Black Cat hits an enemy carrying a Spider-Tracer with any other ability, she triggers the mark to deal bonus damage. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Spider-Man, using Spider-Web Grapple to hit an enemy already marked with a Spider-Tracer temporarily Immobilizes them in place.

abilities.name: Vibranium Claws
abilities.text: Slice Vibranium Claws forward

abilities.name: Bast's Descent
abilities.text: Summon Bast, pouncing forward, dealing damage, and attaching a Vibranium Mark to enemies hit while refreshing Spirit Rend

abilities.name: Spirit Rend
abilities.text: Lunge forward and deal damage to enemies. Vibranium Mark produces Bonus Health and refreshes the ability

abilities.name: Spinning Kick
abilities.text: Spiral forward and attach a Vibranium Mark to enemies hit

abilities.name: Subtle Step
abilities.text: Hold Space to run on a wall; perform a jump after detaching from the wall

abilities.name: Spear Toss
abilities.text: Toss a Vibranium energy spear forward, creating a Vibranium Force Field and attaching a Vibranium Mark to enemies in its radius

abilities.name: Panther's Cunning
abilities.text: Deal higher damage when at low Health

abilities.name: GAMMA VIBRANIUM ARMOR
abilities.text: Hulk charges Namor and Black Panther with gamma radiation. Namor can summon an extra Gamma Monstro which will continuously fire gamma rays at locked-on enemies. The longer the rays hit, the higher the damage. Black Panther's Vibranium armor is enhanced; when his health is low he receives a gamma shield, blocking incoming attacks and becoming Unstoppable

abilities.name: DAMISA-YAO
abilities.text: Base Effect: Triggers the elemental power within his armor, dealing damage and applying Slow to surrounding enemies while attaching Vibranium Marks. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, enemies within range are launched toward Black Panther.

abilities.name: DIMENSIONAL SHORTCUT
abilities.text: Base Effect: Activate a Limbo stepping disc to instantly return to your position from a few seconds ago, gaining Bonus Health in the process. When the teleport ends, the disc collapses in an explosion, damaging nearby enemies and applying Vibranium Marks. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magik, the teleportation sequence can be manually canceled mid-transit.

abilities.name: Widow's Bite Baton
abilities.text: Strike with the enhanced electric batons

abilities.name: Red Room Rifle
abilities.text: Attack with the Red Room Rifle

abilities.name: ASSASSIN'S FOCUS
abilities.text: Switch the Red Room Rifle to sniper mode. Shots fired in this state pierce through targets and deal increased damage

abilities.name: ELECTRO-PLASMA BLAST
abilities.text: Fire an electro-plasma round forward. Upon hitting the environment or an enemy, it explodes and applies a Slow effect

abilities.name: EDGE DANCER
abilities.text: Unleash a spinning kick to Launch Up enemies. Landing the hit will allow her to zip to the target with a grappling hook for a second kick

abilities.name: WIDOW'S BITE SLAM
abilities.text: Leap toward a target area and slam the ground with her Widow's Bite gauntlet, dealing damage to enemies within range

abilities.name: ALLIED AGENTS
abilities.text: Base Effect: Landing hits with Red Room Rifle builds Focus. At three stacks, enter a Focused state where the next bullet gains the Hunter's Sight effect, granting Damage Boost and pierce effects. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hawkeye, landing a critical hit prevents the Focused state from expiring, allowing continuous enhanced fire until missing a crit.

abilities.name: BURNING BULLETS
abilities.text: Base Effect: Activation grants the Red Room Rifle a Fire Rate Boost. Additionally, the Plasma Cannon projectile becomes a hitscan laser that no longer requires charging. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, her Plasma Cannon gains a second ability charge.

abilities.name: Ancestral Sword
abilities.text: Slash forward with Blade's Ancestral Sword

abilities.name: Hunter's Shotgun
abilities.text: Fire at enemies using your Shotgun

abilities.name: Scarlet Shroud
abilities.text: Parry with Ancestral Sword to become Unstoppable for a brief period, reducing damage taken from the front and decreasing the cooldown of Daywalker Dash

abilities.name: Bloodline Awakening
abilities.text: Awaken the Dhampir bloodline, enhancing slash speed during continuous attacks and triggering Whirlwind Slash.If all Whirlwind Slash strikes hit, your Attack Speed will further increase. While under this state, you suffer Reduced Healing, but attacks gain Lifesteal

abilities.name: Daywalker Dash
abilities.text: Dash forward. If wielding your gun, shoot at enemies upon impact, applying a Healing Reduction effect. If wielding your sword, deliver a cleaving strike that inflicts Slow

abilities.name: Thousand-Fold Slash
abilities.text: Charge power and swiftly draw the Sword of Dracula, executing a powerful Iaido strike as you dash forward, leaving behind a slashing zone where the sword automatically strikes enemies. Enemies hit suffer Reduced Healing

abilities.name: ECLIPSE EDGE
abilities.text: Blessed by Khonshu, Blade gains a new ability. When activated, Blade swings his Ancestral Sword in a powerful slash, dashing forward a short distance. At the end of the dash, he swiftly slashes four times, each strike sending a Darkmoon Blade forward. When a Darkmoon Blade hits an enemy, it bounces to nearby targets

abilities.name: BLADE OF KHONSHU
abilities.text: Base Effect: Perform a heavy forward cleave with the Ancestral Sword while performing a short dash. At the end of the dash, swiftly slash four times, each strike sending a Darkmoon Blade forward. When a Darkmoon Blade hits an enemy, it bounces to nearby targets. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Moon Knight, each Whirlwind Slash triggered generates one additional Darkmoon Blade.

abilities.name: BLEED FOR BATTLE
abilities.text: Base Effect: For every set amount of damage taken, Blade builds a stack of Bloodline Awakening. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Captain America, taking critical damage instantly triggers the Bloodline Awakening state, gaining bonus stacks while raising the overall stack cap.

abilities.name: Sentinel Strike
abilities.text: Get up close to strike enemies. Landing the second hit enables a shield throw that can ricochet four times

abilities.name: Freedom Charge
abilities.text: Shield held high, carve a path forward, granting both himself and allies along the path continuous Bonus Health and Movement Boosts. Allies also gain Ultimate Ability Charge Acceleration. Using Living Legend and Leading Dash while this ability is active can Launch Up enemies

abilities.name: Leading Dash
abilities.text: Boost speed and enable Fearless Leap to leap into the air

abilities.name: Vibranium Energy Saw
abilities.text: Hurl the energy-charged shield to strike enemies in a path

abilities.name: Liberty Rush
abilities.text: Raise the shield and charge forward

abilities.name: Super-Soldier Slam
abilities.text: Slam down from the sky onto the targeted area, Launching Up enemies

abilities.name: Living Legend
abilities.text: Raise the shield to deflect incoming projectiles, sending them ricocheting in random directions

abilities.name: Captain's Spirit
abilities.text: Inspired by Captain America's resolve, Winter Soldier can leap to the aid of a designated ally, slamming the ground with his mechanical arm to deal damage to nearby foes. Additionally, Captain America and Winter Soldier can interact with each other once both parties confirm. The duo collides and unleashes a shockwave that deals damage and inflicts slow on enemies

abilities.name: VIBRANIUM BASTION
abilities.text: Black Cat shares her luck with her allies. When White Fox embraces her newfound fortune, she unleashestracking Spirit Tails to grant Healing and Speed to allies, while damaging and Slowing foes. When Captain America enjoys his luck, his shield's block radius expands and allows him to aim deflectedProjectiles directly toward his target

abilities.name: STARS ALIGNED
abilities.text: Base Effect: Captain America can leap directly to a teammate, providing Bonus Health to both himself and the ally, while redirecting a portion of their incoming damage to himself. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Winter Soldier, the duo can trigger a mutual rally. Upon confirmation, they charge at one another, slamming together to grant Bonus Health and Movement Speed to all nearby friends. The original effect remains, now additionally granting a Speed Boost to the targeted teammate.

abilities.name: VOLTAIC UNION
abilities.text: Base Effect: Modifies Sentinel Strike into a Lightning Shield projectile. After landing two hits, Captain America launches the piercing Lightning Shield four times. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor, the lightning energy imbued in the shield intensifies. Each hit from the Lightning Shield triggers an extra burst of damage in the surrounding area.

abilities.name: Darkforce Cloak
abilities.text: Inflict continuous damage on an enemy

abilities.name: Eternal Bond
abilities.text: Perform four rapid dashes, healing allies and damaging enemies along the path

abilities.name: Terror Cape
abilities.text: Deploy a Veil of Darkforce to damage enemies upon touch, applying Blind to narrow their sight and Vulnerability to amplify damage received

abilities.name: Dark Teleportation
abilities.text: Enshroud nearby allies in the Darkforce Dimension, plunging them into the Phased state, making them untargetable and invisible to enemies and granting them a Movement Boost

abilities.name: FROM SHADOW TO LIGHT
abilities.text: Cloak & Dagger inject light and dark energy into Hawkeye's katana. When Hawkeye uses Crescent Slash, enemies hit are launched back, and a blade wave filled with light and energy sweeps forward. This wave passes through both allies and enemies: it heals and boosts healing for allies, while damaging enemies and applying Vulnerability

abilities.name: Lightforce Dagger
abilities.text: Unleash a bouncing Lightforce Dagger to damage enemies and heal nearby allies

abilities.name: Veil of Lightforce
abilities.text: Deploy a Veil of Lightforce to heal allies upon touch and grant them a Healing Boost

abilities.name: Dagger Storm
abilities.text: Launch a volley of daggers, creating a Healing Over Time field in the impact area

abilities.name: OBLIVION SHROUD
abilities.text: Base Effect: Veil of Lightforce and Terror Cape are warped by hellfire energy, changing into Veil of Light and Veil of Darkness while retaining their original effects. After traveling a set distance, the veils halt in place. Enemy damage passing through the Veil of Light is weakened, while enemy healing passing through the Veil of Darkness suffers Healing Reduction. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the width of both the Veil of Light and Veil of Darkness expands. Additionally, allies passing through the veils are empowered by hellfire energy, gaining Damage Boost for a duration.

abilities.name: FROZEN HAVEN
abilities.text: Base Effect: Channel frost energy outward to encase yourself in an absolute block of ice. This offers great protection, but Freezes you in place. While frozen, you can be healed and emit a weak healing aura to nearby allies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Luna Snow, the healing aura provided to allies while Frozen becomes significantly stronger.

abilities.name: Optic Blast
abilities.text: Fire a quick burst of kinetic force forward. Hitting enemies accelerates Ricochet Force charge rate

abilities.name: Concussive Beam
abilities.text: Continuously fire a powerful beam that can refract between enemies and the environment. Hitting enemies accelerates Ricochet Force charge rate

abilities.name: Ricochet Force
abilities.text: Fire a beam that can diffract and track nearby enemies after hitting terrain. Upon use, Cyclops gains Bonus Health

abilities.name: Propulsion Burst
abilities.text: Fire a propulsion beam to push yourself and the target backward, applying a Slow effect to the enemy

abilities.name: Optic Ascent
abilities.text: Fire a propulsion beam directly downward to push yourself up and knock back hit enemies, applying a Slow effect to them

abilities.name: Kinetic Hover
abilities.text: Enter a slow-fall state while firing Concussive Beam mid-air

abilities.name: Ruby Rage
abilities.text: Remove visor and fire a powerful sweeping beam forward. The blast leaves behind volatile excess energy that erupts, dealing massive secondary explosive damage

abilities.name: Red Adamantium
abilities.text: Cyclops supercharges Wolverine's claws, extending his attack range. While active, Wolverine's Vicious Rampage is replaced with Kinetic Claws, granting him a brief forward lunge that unleashes a flurry of slashes around him

abilities.name: SLIM AND RED
abilities.text: Base Effect: Hitting an enemy with Ricochet Force summons the Phoenix Force to ignite them, causing continuous burn damage over a set duration. Hitting an ignited target with Optic Blast or Concussive Beam instantly triggers a percentage of the remaining burn damage as a single burst. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, Spark detonations reduce the cooldown of Ricochet Force.

abilities.name: KINETIC KIN
abilities.text: Base Effect: Release stored kinetic energy to enter an enhanced state for a duration. While active, Cyclops gains significantly increased movement speed and jump height. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, during the enhanced state, the attack speeds for both Optic Blast and Concussive Beam are increased.

abilities.name: JUSTICE JAB
abilities.text: Swing Billy Clubs forward. Gain Fury on hit

abilities.name: RIGHTEOUS CROSS
abilities.text: Cross your Billy Clubs and surge forward. Gain Fury on hit

abilities.name: OBJECTION!
abilities.text: Whirl billy clubs in a tight guard to block frontal damage and reflect projectiles, becoming immune to all incoming harm during this stance and gain Fury

abilities.name: DEVIL'S LATCH
abilities.text: Fire a grappling line that reels Daredevil and his target toward each other. On completion, gain Fury and temporarily enables Cross Interrogation

abilities.name: INFERNAL FURY
abilities.text: Expend Fury to unleash Devil's Chain or Devil's Throw. Devil's Chain converts damage into Bonus Health, while Devil's Throw Slows enemies on hit and temporarily enables Cross Interrogation

abilities.name: Sonic Pursuit
abilities.text: Locks onto a target, gaining increased Speed; and Damage Reduction when attacked. While in range, dash to the target, Blinding them and restore Fury

abilities.name: RADAR SENSE
abilities.text: Detect enemy movements within a set radius

abilities.name: BLIND ASCENT
abilities.text: Run along walls and spring off them to reposition

abilities.name: LET THE DEVIL OUT
abilities.text: Embrace the Beast within. Enemies in Daredevil's line of sight take damage and suffer a ramping Blind effect. Continually gain Fury while active

abilities.name: BLIND VERDICT
abilities.text: Daredevil shares the location of his Sonic Pursuit target with The Punisher. At the same time, The Punisher can launch a devil-infused shock grenade to damage and blind enemies

abilities.name: COMPREHENSIVE DEFENSE
abilities.text: Base Effect: Objection! is enhanced. Whirling billy clubs now damage all enemies in range while deflecting Projectiles from all directions. Successfully deflecting attacks recovers Fury. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Fist, Daredevil passively recovers Health for the entire duration of the ability.

abilities.name: DEVILISH AFFAIR
abilities.text: Base Effect: Swings Devil's Chain in a criss-cross pattern, dealing damage to enemies in front and inflicting a Slow. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Widow, the damage radius is expanded, and landing hits recovers Fury.

abilities.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - VANGUARD
abilities.text: Nobody lays a finger on my teammates! Anyone tries, and I'm firing these big boy bullets straight at their face!

abilities.name: THE BAN HAMMER
abilities.text: You! Yeah, you - the hyper one! Eyes off my friends. I sentence you to...whatever! Get ready to be taunted. I get bonus HP and healing, and if you whiff your abilities, you take damage, and I get even more HP!

abilities.name: MAGICAL UNICORN SHIELD!
abilities.text: Plushie power! It stops every single attack those chumps throw, giving my team a safety bubble. It's cute AND bulletproof

abilities.name: BUNNY BOUNCE
abilities.text: Yup, I can double jump in midair! During The Big Test and its upgrade, I can also stomp heads and wall jump to reset its cooldown. Stomp enemies so hard they won't get near my team!

abilities.name: HEALING FACTOR
abilities.text: Out of combat? I'm healing up, staying battle-ready to protect my team. And if I'm about to croak? Surprise! I get a free pass, and my health zooms back up. Nice try, villains

abilities.name: MAXIMUM FLAIR
abilities.text: Listen up, eyes on the prize, don't wander off! Every time my abilities land on a bad guy, the style points shoot up a notch! When it's full, I can pop my ultimate! With me on the team, you're all staying alive and fabulous!

abilities.name: UPGRADE!
abilities.text: I'm here to smack baddies, get XP, and shield my friends! When my XP is full, I get to upgrade an ability! Bonus: Score the final hit and force your foe into a selfie—more XP for me! I'm invincible while striking my best duckface. No photobombs!

abilities.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - VANGUARD
abilities.text: Want to hurt my team? Good luck! I hit you with a taunt, mess up your vision, and burn your health nonstop! Best part: my swords and guns go full turbo for the duration. Blink and you'll miss it

abilities.name: Comical Chaos
abilities.text: Deadpool hands Jeff the Land Shark a plushie with attitude. Jeff can spit it ahead where it'll continuously Taunt nearby enemies and Block Vision, while allies in range enjoy a plush-powered healing party!

abilities.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - VANGUARD
abilities.text: Protecting my team means my katanas go full savage. No mercy for the baddies!

abilities.name: THE BIG TEST
abilities.text: Wake the #!&% up, hero! We've got a game to win! Speed and healing buffs for starters, bonus Hazardous Hijinks for me, and extra HP for me and my nearby friends. Hit enough baddies with the right abilities exactly as I ask, and you unlock mega speed and healing, plus reset my Healing Factor cooldown!. Team protection mode: activated!

abilities.name: HAZARDOUS HIJINKS - VANGUARD
abilities.text: Try getting to my teammates, I dare you! My dash slash knocks fools down, and if I hit, I get to do it again. Up to three times, baby!

abilities.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - VANGUARD UPGRADED
abilities.text: I rack up shots, then, BOOM! A mind-blowing bubble bomb for all the enemies. Teammate security: maximum

abilities.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - VANGUARD UPGRADED
abilities.text: Relax, you've got Deadpool on your side! Swords out, baddies out. My stab hits crit, and a Bad Bunny hit makes the next swing a stabby special

abilities.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - VANGUARD UPGRADED
abilities.text: Teammates, stay safe! Dummies, look here! It's showtime: I taunt, blind you, and hit warp speed with my swords and guns. Plus, my crew gets a damage reduction buff, so they're basically invincible. Dummies that stick around too long will even have their UI taped over!

abilities.name: HAZARDOUS HIJINKS - VANGUARD UPGRADED
abilities.text: Watch this pro bodyguard in action! I dash forward, nail the bad guy, and bounce in any direction I want. Oh, and I can do this two more times real quick!

abilities.name: MAGICAL UNICORN SHIELD! - UPGRADED
abilities.text: My ultra-cool, super shiny, extra huggable, and totally blinged-out plushy. Toss it ahead, and it lands as an invincible sphere of awesomeness! Blocking attacks and keeping my team safe inside our furry fortress

abilities.name: THE BIG TEST - UPGRADED
abilities.text: Hey, player! Warm-up's over, time for the main event! Speed, healing, dashes, for me, and bonus HP for all! Smash enough baddies with the skills I say, and you unlock super buffs (massive speed and healing), plus Healing Factor resets. For some time after, each hit means more HP for the crew and you. Don't mess this up!

abilities.name: THE BAN HAMMER - UPGRADED
abilities.text: Upgraded courtroom drama! Congrats, unlucky one! You're my pick; enjoy the taunt! I score bonus health and healing, and you take ongoing damage. If you miss an ability while court is in session, it's a double whammy. You get more pain, AND I get more extra HP! Thanks in advance!

abilities.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - DUELIST
abilities.text: Bang! Bang! Unleash two hand cannons left and right, because one gun is never enough. Pew pew, baby!

abilities.name: SKILL ISSUE
abilities.text: Let's play judge! Pick a dumb-dumb and slap a taunt. They miss an ability? Boom! Gavel drops, and I slap them with pain and snark

abilities.name: HEADSHOT! - DUELIST
abilities.text: Ever seen someone throw their own face? Watch me KO a crowd, then catch my mug on the rebound!. Don't lose your head over it

abilities.name: BUNNY HOP
abilities.text: Hippity-hoppity, Deadpool's on your property! Watch me squeeze in a second jump midair! Hop on heads or kick off walls with Bunny Hop to refresh the cooldown, and if I land on someone? Free health for me, and a headache for them. Whee!

abilities.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - DUELIST
abilities.text: True heroes taunt face-to-face! I roast nearby baddies, mess up their vision, and tank their hits like a boss. Try me!

abilities.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - DUELIST
abilities.text: Slicey, dicey, twice as nicey! Swing both swords at whoever gets too close. Sushi, anyone?

abilities.name: POP QUIZ!
abilities.text: Hey, you! Yeah, you! Ready for a challenge? Free speed and healing just for trying. Nail enough hits with the right abilities and unlock the deluxe speed-heal package. It's an A+ in chaos!

abilities.name: HAZARDOUS HIJINKS - DUELIST
abilities.text: Blink, and you'll miss my deadly dash combo. Slash, dash, repeat! Hit someone? You get to go again! (Up to 2 more times. Don't get greedy.) Who says I can't multitask?

abilities.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - DUELIST UPGRADED
abilities.text: Keep blasting till you trigger a BOOM. My thoughts literally explode onto the battlefield. Talk about mind-blowing firepower!

abilities.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - DUELIST UPGRADED
abilities.text: Now with extra chop! Stabs can go straight for the noggin. Heads up! Do a Bunny Hop and POW! Stabby Stabby action guaranteed! Run while you can!

abilities.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - DUELIST UPGRADED
abilities.text: Check out the best trash talk in the Chronoverse! Keep taunting and melting their HP! I even block their screen, so they can't see squat. Plus, I tank hits like a champ. Enemies that stick around too long get the bottom of their screen taped up. By the end, they won't even find their health bar and whatnot. Good luck fighting what you can't see, suckers!

abilities.name: HAZARDOUS HIJINKS - DUELIST UPGRADED
abilities.text: Now with bouncy castle action! Slash, bounce, repeat. It's like the world's deadliest pinball!. Cooldowns? Never heard of 'em. Keep going as long as you hit stuff, just don't let me fall flat on my ass!

abilities.name: HEADSHOT! - DUELIST UPGRADED
abilities.text: Juggle my noggin for extra throws! If you catch it thrice, it goes kaboom. Everyone gets a piece of my mind

abilities.name: POP QUIZ! - UPGRADED
abilities.text: Don't just stand there, you blockhead! The challenge's still rolling. But don't worry, I'm not one of those money-hungry scam artists. The buffs are on the house, no price hike. Take on this challenge, and you'll get three freebies: a little Speed boost, Continuous Healing, and Damage Up. Hit enough baddies with the right abilities exactly as I ask, and you unlock the ultimate bundle (Super Speed, Super Healing, Damage Boost AND reset all your cooldowns (except Healing Factor; no cheating!). Now THAT'S love

abilities.name: SKILL ISSUE - UPGRADED
abilities.text: Dumbpoochu, I choose you! Taunt time! Their HP melts away, and if they whiff an ability, they get bonus pain AND Vulnerability. Double whammy! Objection? Overruled!

abilities.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - STRATEGIST
abilities.text: Nobody lays a finger on my teammates! Anyone tries, and I'm firing these big boy bullets straight at their face!

abilities.name: PWNAGE POUND
abilities.text: You! Yeah, you - the hyper one! Eyes off my friends. I sentence you to...whatever! Get ready to be taunted. I get bonus HP and healing, and if you whiff your abilities, you take damage, and I get even more HP!

abilities.name: BOUNCING BOBBLEHEAD - STRATEGIST
abilities.text: Plushie power! It stops every single attack those chumps throw, giving my team a safety bubble. It's cute AND bulletproof

abilities.name: HEALING HOP
abilities.text: Yup, I can double jump in midair! During The Big Test and its upgrade, I can also stomp heads and wall jump to reset its cooldown. Stomp enemies so hard they won't get near my team!

abilities.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - STRATEGIST
abilities.text: Want to hurt my team? Good luck! I hit you with a taunt, mess up your vision, and burn your health nonstop! Best part: my swords and guns go full turbo for the duration. Blink and you'll miss it

abilities.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - STRATEGIST
abilities.text: Protecting my team means my katanas go full savage. No mercy for the baddies!

abilities.name: FINAL EXAM
abilities.text: Wake the #!&% up, hero! We've got a game to win! Speed and healing buffs for starters, bonus Healing Hijinks for me, and extra HP for me and my nearby friends. Hit enough baddies with the right abilities exactly as I ask, and you unlock mega speed and healing, plus reset my Healing Factor cooldown!. Team protection mode: activated!

abilities.name: HEALING HIJINKS - STRATEGIST
abilities.text: Try getting to my teammates, I dare you! My dash slash knocks fools down, and if I hit, I get to do it again. Up to three times, baby!

abilities.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
abilities.text: I rack up shots, then, BOOM! A mind-blowing bubble bomb for all the enemies. Teammate security: maximum

abilities.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
abilities.text: Relax, you've got Deadpool on your side! Swords out, baddies out. My stab hits crit, and a Healing Hop hit makes the next swing a stabby special

abilities.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
abilities.text: Teammates, stay safe! Dummies, look here! It's showtime: I taunt, blind you, and hit warp speed with my swords and guns. Plus, my crew gets a damage reduction buff, so they're basically invincible. Dummies that stick around too long will even have their UI taped over!

abilities.name: HEALING HIJINKS - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
abilities.text: Watch this pro bodyguard in action! I dash forward, nail the bad guy, and bounce in any direction I want. Oh, and I can do this two more times real quick!

abilities.name: BOUNCING BOBBLEHEAD - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
abilities.text: My ultra-cool, super shiny, extra huggable, and totally blinged-out plushy. Toss it ahead, and it lands as an invincible sphere of awesomeness! Blocking attacks and keeping my team safe inside our furry fortress

abilities.name: FINAL EXAM - UPGRADED
abilities.text: Hey, player! Warm-up's over, time for the main event! Speed, healing, dashes, for me, and bonus HP for all! Smash enough baddies with the skills I say, and you unlock super buffs(massive speed and healing), plus Healing Factor resets. For some time after, each hit means more HP for the crew and you. Don't mess this up!

abilities.name: PWNAGE POUND - UPGRADED
abilities.text: Upgraded courtroom drama! Congrats, unlucky one! You're my pick; enjoy the taunt! I score bonus health and healing, and you take ongoing damage. If you miss an ability while court is in session, it's a double whammy. You get more pain, AND I get more extra HP! Thanks in advance!

abilities.name: "HEL-YEAH, HONEY"
abilities.text: Base Effect: Receive upgrades from Hel, allowing the Desert Eagles or Katanas to be upgraded one additional time. Hel-Yeah Desert Eagles: Duelist and Vanguard gain pierce, and the thought bubbles transform into homing death-rattle bubbles. Strategist death-rattle bubbles also home in on allies, exploding to provide healing. Hel-Yeah Katanas: Every strike injects undead energy into the enemy. Hitting an enemy three times with the Katanas detonates the energy, dealing percentage-based true damage scaling off their max Health. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, BOTH the Desert Eagles and Katanas can be upgraded one extra time.

abilities.name: GUMBO CHIMICHANGAS
abilities.text: Base Effect: Activate for kinetic energy, propelling Deadpool in a forward leap. Upon landing, he scatters a ring of kinetically charged chimichangas that deal damage to enemies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, the kinetic energy causes Deadpool's landing to inflict a Stun effect on enemies in the blast radius.

abilities.name: Primal Bite
abilities.text: Bite forward. Applies a Bleed that deals continuous Percentage Damage

abilities.name: Impact Beam
abilities.text: Unleash a devastating beam of energy that inflicts a Bleed and Slow.

abilities.name: Buddy Barrier
abilities.text: Activate the heart-shaped generator to expand a spherical shield that blocks incoming damage. Enemies caught within are Slowed

abilities.name: Savage Predation
abilities.text: Dash and pounce on your prey with a vicious bite, applying a Bleed. If the target is already Bleeding, clamp down before hurling them away

abilities.name: Frenzied Feast
abilities.text: Unleash a flurry of continuous bites, converting the damage dealt into Bonus Health. Deals extra damage against Bleeding targets

abilities.name: Prehistoric Plating
abilities.text: Take reduced damage from headshots. Immune to launch-up, knock-back, and other displacement effects. Enemies and allies generate less Ultimate Ability Energy when damaging or healing him

abilities.name: Apex Advantage
abilities.text: Gain Bonus Health when you inflict Bleeding upon an enemy

abilities.name: Devil-Beast Rampage
abilities.text: Erupt in primal fury! Gain a massive Movement Speed Boost while unleashing earth-shattering stomps that Launch enemies and applies a Bleed. Thunderous roars also emit sonic waves that Slow enemies hit

abilities.name: Prehistoric Partner
abilities.text: The Punisher rides atop Devil Dinosaur, restricting him to only Adjudication/Deliverance and Scourge Grenade while disabling other abilities. While mounted, Devil Dinosaur absorbs a portion of all damage inflicted on The Punisher

abilities.name: PRIMAL PUNISHMENT
abilities.text: Base Effect: Adds a new ability. Upon activation, Primal Bite is replaced. Devil Dinosaur gains 2 magnetic cannons that can be fired forward; the cannonballs detonate when hitting enemies or the environment. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Punisher, the duo can request an interaction. Once accepted, The Punisher rides atop Devil Dinosaur, restricting him to only Adjudication/Deliverance and Scourge Grenade while disabling other abilities. While mounted, The Punisher gains Damage Reduction; Devil Dinosaur absorbs a portion of all damage inflicted on The Punisher.

abilities.name: SURF & TURF
abilities.text: Base Effect: Impact Beam is replaced by a frontal water spray. This stream damages enemies while providing healing to teammates. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, Jeff can ride atop Devil Dinosaur's head. While riding, both gain some Damage Reduction and are swirled in therapeutic waters, receiving Continuous Healing. Jeff can only cast Joyful Splash, Aqua Burst, and Healing Bubble during this time.

abilities.name: Daggers of Denak
abilities.text: Cast Daggers of Denak forward

abilities.name: Eye of Agamotto
abilities.text: Separate nearby enemies' Souls from their bodies. Damage dealt to these Souls is transferred to their physical bodies

abilities.name: Cloak of Levitation
abilities.text: Ascend and then enter a brief state of sustained flight

abilities.name: Maelstrom of Madness
abilities.text: Release Dark Magic to deal damage to nearby enemies

abilities.name: Pentagram of Farallah
abilities.text: Open portals between two locations, enabling all units to travel through them

abilities.name: Shield of the Seraphim
abilities.text: Create a protective barrier against damage

abilities.name: Price of Magic
abilities.text: Dark Magic accumulates with every hit on an enemy. If Dark Magic peaks for too long, Doctor Strange will be cursed with Anti-Heal

abilities.name: Enchanted Enhancement
abilities.text: Doctor Strange shares his arcane mastery, replacing Scarlet Witch's Chthonian Burst with Mystic Burst upon activation. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction

abilities.name: PSIONIC VORTEX
abilities.text: Invisible Woman enhances Doctor Strange's Maelstrom of Madness with a psionic explosion. The explosion damages and pulls enemies toward Doctor Strange. Based on the explosion's damage, Doctor Strange and nearby allies gain Bonus Health

abilities.name: GAMMA MAELSTROM
abilities.text: Base Effect: Upgrade Maelstrom of Madness to Gamma Maelstrom. This drastically boosts energy charge rates and removes the Anti-Heal curse. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, releasing Gamma Maelstrom retains some energy, and stored Gamma energy doesn't decay over time.

abilities.name: MONSTER-PIERCER
abilities.text: Unleash your elephant gun forward. Bullets pierce enemies and deal high damage

abilities.name: INHERITED INSTINCT
abilities.text: Dealing damage increases hunting Instinct. Defeating enemies caught by Smoky Snare grants additional Instinct. Higher Instinct reduces the cooldown of Helix Advance

abilities.name: RUTHLESS PURSUIT
abilities.text: Dash forward, gaining Bonus Health and launching enemies hit. Follow up with a Double-Barrel Blaster shot that propels you backward and Slows enemies. Using either stage empowers your next Double-Barrel Blaster, transforming it into Monster-Piercer

abilities.name: HELIX ADVANCE
abilities.text: Dash forward. Your next Double-Barrel Blaster becomes Monster-Piercer

abilities.name: LIVING BULLET
abilities.text: Fire a Living Bullet round that splits upon impact, seeking nearby enemies and marking each with a Spectral Sigil. Hitting marked targets with Double-Barrel Blaster or Monster-Piercer grants Elsa a brief Speed boost. Living Bullets deal extra damage to shields and enemies with Bonus Health

abilities.name: SMOKY SNARE
abilities.text: Launch a trap containing the monster Diablo. Once deployed, it becomes Invisible and Invulnerable. When an enemy triggers it, Diablo Immobilizes and Damages them. Use to dash to the trapped enemy. Enemies can destroy Diablo to break free

abilities.name: APEX PREDATOR
abilities.text: Summon the Glartrox to charge forward. The Glartrox can be recalled to charge back toward Elsa. When colliding with terrain or upon return, it bites fiercely, dealing heavy damage

abilities.name: BLOODSTONE'S BOOMBOX BULLETS
abilities.text: Deadpool hands Jeff the Land Shark a plushie. Jeff can spit it ahead where it'll continuously Taunt nearby enemies and Block Vision, while allies in range are healed! Elsa Bloodstone's Living Bullet changes to special rounds that Taunt targets with Deadpool's chatter, while Slowing, and damaging nearby enemies over time. Elsa can recall the rounds to heal based on damage dealt

abilities.name: PREHISTORIC TRAP
abilities.text: Base Effect: After deploying the Smoky Snare trap, Diablo will monitor the area. If enemies approach, Diablo Immobilizes and Damages them. He also releases a lethal gas, causing continuous area damage. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Devil Dinosaur, Elsa can store and deploy two Smoky Snares.

abilities.name: LOUDMOUTH MERCS
abilities.text: Base Effect: Living Bullet changes to special rounds that Taunt targets with Deadpool's chatter, while Slowing, and damaging nearby enemies over time. After a timer, the bullet auto-recalls, healing Elsa based on the damage dealt while adding one extra gauge block to her Inherited Instinct passive cap. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Deadpool, Deadpool breaks the fourth wall, significantly boosting Instinct acquisition rate.

abilities.name: TELEPATHIC PULSE
abilities.text: Fire a psionic beam to deal damage; the longer the beam hits, the higher the damage

abilities.name: MIND'S AEGIS
abilities.text: Create a levitating barrier at the designated location

abilities.name: PSYCHIC SPEAR
abilities.text: Seize control of an enemy's sentience—damage dealt to the sentience cascades to the physical form and can be pierced by Telepathic Pulse. When the sentience shatters, it unleashes extra damage on its owner

abilities.name: DIAMOND FORM
abilities.text: Activate Diamond Form to transform your attack style while gaining Damage Reduction and becoming Unstoppable

abilities.name: FACETED FURY
abilities.text: In Diamond Form, deliver a crushing double-fisted strike to enemies

abilities.name: CRYSTAL KICK
abilities.text: In Diamond Form, unleash a flying kick forward and knock back enemies; extra damage is dealt if they're propelled into a wall

abilities.name: CARBON CRUSH
abilities.text: In Diamond Form, lunge forward to grab an enemy, then execute a back slam to inflict damage

abilities.name: PSIONIC SEDUCTION
abilities.text: Project a forward psychic assault that stuns foes and prevents them from unleashing their Ultimate Abilities; if the effect lingers, it gradually commandeers their mind, forcing them to move toward Emma Frost

abilities.name: ICED OUT DIAMOND
abilities.text: Luna Snow grants Winter's Chill to Iron Fist and Emma Frost. When Iron Fist activates Harmony Recovery, he can heal nearby allies with Lunar Chi. Emma Frost can project ice energy forward, dealing damage and slowing enemies. She can also enhance her diamond form, condensing frost into an Absolute Zero Diamond barrier that blocks enemy attacks and movement

abilities.name: SPIRIT BREAKER
abilities.text: Base Effect: Deals damage to the summoned Soul Crystal, which can be converted into Bonus Healthfor yourself. Enhanced Effect: When Emma Frost teams up with Mantis, shattering the Soul Crystalgrants a one-time Bonus Healthand reduces the cooldown of Mind Control.

abilities.name: Kinetic Cards
abilities.text: Launch three kinetic-charged cards in an arc ahead. Each card detonates on impact, creating a single-target explosion that damages enemies and heals allies

abilities.name: Ragin' Royal Flush
abilities.text: Lock onto an ally within sight and unleash multiple Aces that heal and Purify. Both enter the Kinetic Transfer state, granting increased Movement Speed and Jump Boost, while enhancing attacks with additional single-target explosive damage and providing the ally with Ultimate Ability Charge Acceleration

abilities.name: Cajun Charge
abilities.text: Side-step forward with bo staff in hand, dashing a short distance

abilities.name: Healing Hearts
abilities.text: Conjure a Heart card by consuming one stack of Sleight of Hand to Heal and switch to the Healing Hearts deck

abilities.name: Breaking Spades
abilities.text: Conjure a Spade card by consuming one stack of Sleight of Hand to gain Damage Boost and switch to the Breaking Spades deck

abilities.name: Bayou Bash
abilities.text: Channel kinetic energy into the bo staff, then slam it into the ground after a sweeping strike, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and heals allies

abilities.name: ACE OF ACES
abilities.text: Gambit charges Magneto's greatsword with kinetic energy. When Magneto activates this ability, Iron Volley is replaced with Ace Greatsword, which detonates upon striking enemies. The explosion leaves residual kinetic energy within the target, inflicting secondary damage after a brief delay

abilities.name: Bridge Boost
abilities.text: While Healing Hearts deck is active, trigger Flush Empowerment to card spring and fire a full deck forward. Cards bounce between allies on impact, granting Health and a Healing Boost

abilities.name: Purifying Pick-Up
abilities.text: While Healing Hearts deck is active, trigger Raise Empowerment to launch a cluster of cards in an arc ahead. Explosions heal nearby allies and Purify them

abilities.name: Explosive Trick
abilities.text: While Breaking Spades deck is active, trigger Flush Empowerment to fire a full set of cards forward. Cards explode on impact, dealing damage while inflicting Reduced Healing

abilities.name: Bidding Barrage
abilities.text: While Breaking Spades deck is active, trigger Raise Empowerment to scattering cards in an arc in all directions. Explosions damage enemies and Launch them up

abilities.name: FAVORABLE ODDS
abilities.text: Base Effect: Throw two magnetic playing cards forward. Upon hitting the environment or a character, the two cards magnetically repel and unfurl, spinning in place for a duration. They heal allies they hit, while damaging and Launchingenemies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, after the duration ends, the magnetic poles of the two cards reverse. They violently slam back together and explode, providing an extra burst of healing to allies and damage to enemies.

abilities.name: SPARKLING STAFF
abilities.text: Base Effect: Twirl your firework-energy enhanced bo staff. The radiating firework sparks provide healing to nearby allies. Concurrently, the staff deals damage to close-range enemies, and the rapid spinning blocks incoming damage from most projectiles. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, both Bayou Bashand Big Easy Impactgain an additional Continuous Healingaura.

abilities.name: All-Black
abilities.text: Unleash up to a 4-strike rapid combo with All-Black the Necrosword

abilities.name: Necro-Power
abilities.text: Charge and launch a symbiote mass forward. Hitting an enemy Slows and teleports nearby Black Berserkers to them, or spawns a new one. Arriving Berserkers unleash a two-strike melee attack to Launch Up nearby enemies before reverting to ranged mode

abilities.name: Shadow Harvest
abilities.text: Warp to a selected Black Berserker, sacrificing it for Bonus Health equal to half its Health and triggering a symbiote explosion. Briefly unlocks Shadow Scythe: fire a piercing shockwave forward. All-Black then becomes a scythe for a set duration or 4 slashes

abilities.name: Black Berserker
abilities.text: Lob a symbiote mass that spawns a Black Berserker on landing to immediately shoot the nearest enemy. If summoned beside an enemy via Necro-Power, it unleashes a two-strike melee attack instead

abilities.name: Living Abyss
abilities.text: Surge forward as an Invincible symbiote mass, leaving a Black Berserker behind and driving all active Berserkers into a Frenzied State. Upon landing, manifest a Necroverse that continuously damages trapped enemies, converting them into Bonus Health

abilities.name: Berserker Swarm
abilities.text: Black Berserker damage grants Gorr Bonus Health. Defeating an enemy instantly spawns a Black Berserker at their location

abilities.name: Twilight of the Gods
abilities.text: Unseal All-Black's true power, transforming it into the Annihilablade. Upon activation, an expanding Necroverse is formed, instantly spawning a Black Berserker next to all enemies caught inside. While active, every slash of the Annihilablade deals devastating damage. The Necroverse moves with Gorr; Berserkers within the field will not expire and remain locked in a perpetual Frenzied State

abilities.name: Ragnarök
abilities.text: Base Effect: Gain a new ability to morph the All-Black into a scythe and execute a sweeping strike, damaging and briefly Grounding nearby enemies. The weapon stays in scythe form for a short duration. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, the scythe's attack range is expanded. Each hit scatters symbiote fragments, granting Bonus Health to Gorr and nearby allies

abilities.name: Hive Mind
abilities.text: Base Effect: Gain a new ability to fire a Symbiote Claw forward, dealing piercing damage to enemies in its path. Upon reaching max distance, it retracts, Launching caught enemies toward Gorr. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, Black Berserkers receive a slight Damage Boost and apply a Slow effect to enemies they strike

abilities.name: Vine Strike
abilities.text: Launch vines to attack enemies

abilities.name: Strangling Prison
abilities.text: Fire a massive vine cluster that pulls nearby enemies to its center and Imprisons them

abilities.name: Thornlash Wall
abilities.text: Target a location and grow a Thornlash Wall. When Awakened, it strikes nearby enemies attacked by Groot and his allies

abilities.name: Ironwood Wall
abilities.text: Target a location and grow an Ironwood Wall. When the wall is Awakened, damage dealt by Groot and nearby allies grants Groot Bonus Health. Groot gains Unstoppable while near Ironwood Walls

abilities.name: Spore Bomb
abilities.text: Throw an explosive Spore Bomb that splits into multiple small explosive spores

abilities.name: Flora Colossus
abilities.text: Wooden walls near Groot will Awaken, activating an extra effect. Right-click while building a wooden wall to continue building additional walls

abilities.name: Furious Flora
abilities.text: Perform a combo with his arms, and the third strike will slightly Launch Up the hit enemy airborne

abilities.name: Wild Wall
abilities.text: Mantis enhances Groot's wooden walls and Loki's Rune Stones with life energy. Groot can additionally unleash a Flower Wall, which, when in Flora Colossus state, restores health to random nearby allies and grants them Damage Reduction. Loki's Rune Stones grant allies within Regeneration Domain a Damage Boost

abilities.name: WILD WALL
abilities.text: Base Effect: Summon a Wild Wall that provides Continuous Healing and Bonus Health to allies within its range. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, the Wild Wall evolves after providing a certain amount of healing, increasing its healing

abilities.name: BUBBLE BUDDIES
abilities.text: Base Effect: Retreat inside a Bubble Shield to enter an Invincible state, granting self-targeted Continuous Healing. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, the healing effect inside the bubble is enhanced, and any excess healing converts into Bonus Health.

abilities.name: Blast Arrow
abilities.text: Shoot three explosive arrows

abilities.name: Hunter's Sight
abilities.text: Capture Afterimages of enemies in his view. Damage dealt to an Afterimage is transferred to the corresponding enemy

abilities.name: Crescent Slash
abilities.text: Unsheathe a katana and slash forward, launching up enemies hit

abilities.name: Hypersonic Arrow
abilities.text: Shoot a Hypersonic Arrow, dealing two instances of damage to enemies in its path and inflicting them with Slow. This ability can Knock Down flying heroes

abilities.name: Ronin Slash
abilities.text: Swing a wakizashi to strike frontal enemies, deflecting all incoming projectiles

abilities.name: Skyward Leap
abilities.text: Perform a double jump in the direction of movement

abilities.name: Archer's Focus
abilities.text: Aim at an enemy to improve focus, enhancing the damage inflicted by Piercing Arrow

abilities.name: MOONLIT SLASH
abilities.text: Cloak & Dagger inject light and dark energy into Hawkeye's katana. When Hawkeye uses Crescent Slash, enemies hit are launched back, and a blade wave filled with light and energy sweeps forward. This wave passes through both allies and enemies: it heals and boosts healing for allies, while damaging enemies and applying Vulnerability

abilities.name: SENBONZAKURA STRIKE
abilities.text: Base Effect: Upgrade Blast Arrow to Psionic Arrow. While drawn, Hawkeye can continuously bank extra Psionic Arrows. Releasing the bowstring rapidly fires all accumulated arrows forward in sequence. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Psylocke, the nocking speed for each Psionic Arrow is significantly quickened, and they explode upon hitting enemies or the environment.

abilities.name: Goddess of Death
abilities.text: Soar into the sky and unleash Nastrond Crows from each hand at will

abilities.name: Astral Flock
abilities.text: Transform into a Nastrond Crow to glide forth, press again to undo the transformation. Gain Bonus Health when the transformation ends

abilities.name: Soul Drainer
abilities.text: Project an explosive Hel sphere to Stun nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Piercing Night
abilities.text: Fire multiple Nightsword thorns that detonate after a delay

abilities.name: Nastrond Crowstorm
abilities.text: Defeating an enemy will generate a Nastrond Crow, exploding after a duration

abilities.name: Hel Tendrils
abilities.text: Venom shares his symbiotes with Jeff and Hela. Hela's Hel Tendrils unleash a symbiotic Hel Sphere. Upon hit, it pulls nearby enemies toward the impact point and links them, slowing enemies that try to escape.

abilities.name: DEATH KNELL
abilities.text: Hela channels energy of the undead to empower Namor. When Namor strikes with his trident, a spectral water column erupts at the target area, slowing enemies hit. Whenever Hela or Namor assist in a KO, an invulnerable Undead Monstro spawns at the fallen enemy's position, automatically attacking the nearest foe for a short time before vanishing

abilities.name: DEEP WRATH
abilities.text: Base Effect: Whenever Hela participates in a KO, an Undead Monstro spawns at the fallen enemy's position. While an Undead Monstro is present, casting Piercing Night will command the Monstro to spit a Nightsword Thorn at the nearest enemy. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Namor, each attack during Goddess of Death spawns an Undead Monstro at the point of impact.

abilities.name: Hero Hulk
abilities.text: 400+300 Regenerative Shield

abilities.name: Puny Banner
abilities.text: Transform from Bruce Banner into Hero Hulk

abilities.name: Gamma Grenade
abilities.text: Launch a Gamma Grenade to inflict damage and Launch Up enemies

abilities.name: Gamma Boost
abilities.text: Hulk charges Iron Man and Namor with gamma radiation. When Iron Man uses Armor Overdrive, he will initiate a gamma upgrade. When Namor receives the radiation, he will summon an extra Gamma Monstro which will continuously fire gamma rays at locked-on enemies. The longer the rays hit, the higher the damage

abilities.name: Heavy Blow
abilities.text: Swing fists forward to punch enemies

abilities.name: HULK SMASH!
abilities.text: Unleash stored gamma energy, transforming from Hero Hulk into Monster Hulk for a limited time period

abilities.name: Indestructible Guard
abilities.text: Generate gamma shields for Hero Hulk and nearby allies, absorbing and converting damage into energy for HULK SMASH

abilities.name: Radioactive Lockdown
abilities.text: Emit gamma energy to irradiate enemies and render them immobilize and immune to all ability effects. Using Heavy Blow or Gamma Burst will prematurely remove this status

abilities.name: Incredible Leap
abilities.text: HOLD Space to perform a charged leap that allows Hero Hulk to Knock a flying enemy to the ground

abilities.name: Gamma Burst
abilities.text: Emit gamma-ray bursts to inflict damage. Reduce Indestructible Guard cooldown upon hit

abilities.name: Gamma Fastball
abilities.text: Wolverine, Hulk can interact with each other. Once both parties confirm, Hulk can lift Wolverine and press the key to hurl him forward

abilities.name: World Breaker
abilities.text: Grab and smash the enemy in front

abilities.name: SAVAGE SLAM
abilities.text: Base Effect: Leap high and smash the ground, dealing damage to enemies and reducing the cooldowns of other abilities based on remaining Health. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Captain America, the ground slam additionally applies Vulnerability to enemies hit.

abilities.name: GAMMA FASTBALL
abilities.text: Base Effect: Enter a Furious state upon activation, gaining Speed Boost and Attack Speed for a duration. Also unlocks the Dances With Werewolves ability, granting Unstoppable for a period when Health drops to a certain threshold. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Wolverine, unlocks the Fastball Special. Upon mutual confirmation, Hulk hurls Wolverine forward

abilities.name: Fire Cluster
abilities.text: Launch forward a splittable fireball

abilities.name: Blazing Blast
abilities.text: Launch a fireball to create a Flame Field at the targeted area

abilities.name: Flaming Meteor
abilities.text: Dive towards the ground, dealing damage to enemies and detonating any Flame Fields hit

abilities.name: Plasma Body
abilities.text: Enter a state of accelerated ascent

abilities.name: Pyro-Prison
abilities.text: Form a fire wall between Fire Fields to burn enemies

abilities.name: Supernova
abilities.text: Explode with cosmic fire to deal damage to enemies within range. Upon skill activation, all Flame Fields will transform into Flame Tornadoes, dealing extra damage

abilities.name: Storm Siblings
abilities.text: The Invisible Woman taps into her powers, channeling Psionic Might to fortify the entire Fantastic Four team, granting damage resistance. Once activated, they can continually generate Bonus Health, making up for lost Health

abilities.name: Pyrokinetic Energy
abilities.text: Human Torch stores Pyrokinetic Energy in Spider-Man's suit, enabling him to unleash an Inferno Blast that sprays a fiery web while performing a backflip to create distance. The flames damage enemies and apply a Burn-Tracer. Detonating these Burn-Tracers inflicts Damage Over Time

abilities.name: Two In One
abilities.text: Human Torch can lift The Thing into the air and slam him down, dealing damage, launching enemies, and creating a zone that disables mobility abilities

abilities.name: FIERY SPARKS
abilities.text: Base Effect: Passively detect enemies in the immediate vicinity and launch tracking Sparks to chip away their health. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, successfully landing a Firework Spark on an enemy grants Human Torch Bonus Health.

abilities.name: STORMING IGNITION
abilities.text: Base Effect: Unleash a storm-driven blaze of fire forward, generating a persistent Fire Vortex upon impact that continuously damages and pulls in enemies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, her Omega Hurricane ignites into a Burning Hurricane if it crosses a Flame Tornado. Furthermore, any Omega Hurricane, Jeff-Nado, or Flame Tornado that sweeps across a Flame Field left by Human Torch will instantly generate a new Flame Tornado.

abilities.name: Orb Projection
abilities.text: Launch a force field orbs that can pierce heroes, flying to maximum distance before returning to Invisible Woman; damaging enemies and healing teammates

abilities.name: Guardian Shield
abilities.text: Generate a force shield in front of a selected ally or in front of you. The shield can block damage and provide Healing Over Time to nearby allies. Enemies that pass through the shield are slowed

abilities.name: Psionic Vortex
abilities.text: Gather psionic energy and then cast it, upon impact or pressing the Ability key again, it erupts into a psionic vortex, continuously drawing in enemies and causing damage

abilities.name: Force Physics
abilities.text: Manipulate psionic energy to push or pull enemies in front of her

abilities.name: Invisible Boundary
abilities.text: Manifest an unseen force field within a chosen area, rendering allies inside undetectable by enemies and provide Healing Over Time. Enemies that pass through the field are slowed

abilities.name: Covert Advance
abilities.text: Enter Invisible state some time after disengaging from combat and grant yourself Healing Over Time

abilities.name: Veiled Step
abilities.text: Generate a force field at your feet, stepping on it propels her into the Invisible state

abilities.name: Fantasti-Force
abilities.text: The Invisible Woman taps into her powers, channeling Psionic Might to fortify Mr.Fantastic. This formidable force bolsters Mr.Fantastic, granting damage resistance. Once activated, they can continually generate Bonus Health, making up for lost Health

abilities.name: UNITED SIBLINGS
abilities.text: Base Effect: Generate a Flame Shield for a targeted ally that blocks incoming damage while providing a Continuous Healing aura to everyone nearby. Projectiles from teammates shot through the Flame Shield receive a Damage Boost. Enemies that pass though the shield are Slowed Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Human Torch, the Flame Shield boasts a larger radius and heavily increased shield value.

abilities.name: FIRST FAMILY
abilities.text: Base Effect: Invisible Woman and surrounding allies enter Invisible state, gaining healing and a Speed Boost. The effect ends if they take damage or the duration expires. Disengaging from combat for a duration will reenter the Invisible state. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mister Fantastic, the healing and Speed Boost effects are enhanced, and the Invisible state duration is increased

abilities.name: Jeet Kune Do
abilities.text: Strike the targeted enemy with Jeet Kune Do, reducing the cooldown of Block and Strike with every hit

abilities.name: Yat Jee Chung Kuen
abilities.text: Dash forward to pursue the targeted enemy and unleash a flurry of attacks

abilities.name: Living Chi
abilities.text: Become living Chi to boost his speed, damage, and attack range, delivering stronger punches while reducing the cooldown of Dragon's Defense

abilities.name: K'un-Lun Kick
abilities.text: Dash forward, delivering a flying kick when hitting an enemy or reaching full range, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Damage increases with lower enemy health

abilities.name: Harmony Recovery
abilities.text: Cross legs and channel Chi, slowly gaining Bonus Health

abilities.name: Crane Leap
abilities.text: Perform up to three consecutive jumps while airborne

abilities.name: Dragon's Defense
abilities.text: Assume a defensive stance with a boost of Chi to block incoming attacks and gain Damage Reduction, then strike back with Yat Jee Chung Kuen

abilities.name: Wall Runner
abilities.text: Run horizontally along the walls

abilities.name: Chi Absorption
abilities.text: Assists in taking down enemies allow him to absorb their Chi and gain Bonus Health

abilities.name: Lunar Chi
abilities.text: Luna Snow grants Winter's Chill to Hawkeye and Iron Fist. When Iron Fist activates Harmony Recovery, he can heal nearby allies with Lunar Chi

abilities.name: IRON & STONE
abilities.text: Base Effect: Unleash a powerful uppercut to Launch Up enemies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up The Thing, unleashing the uppercut can be chained directly into a sweeping leg sweep for a follow-up attack.

abilities.name: KUMIHO PALM
abilities.text: Base Effect: Hitting an enemy with Yat Jee Chung Kuen provides a burst of healing to nearby allies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up White Fox, the lock-on distance for Yat Jee Chung Kuen is significantly increased.

abilities.name: Repulsor Blast
abilities.text: Fire nano pulse cannons forward

abilities.name: Repulsor Blast (Armor Overdrive)
abilities.text: Fire nano pulse cannons forward

abilities.name: Unibeam
abilities.text: Fire nano pulse cannons forward

abilities.name: Unibeam (Armor Overdrive)
abilities.text: Fire nano pulse cannons forward

abilities.name: Invincible Pulse Cannon
abilities.text: Fire a devastating pulse cannon in the targeted direction, delivering catastrophic damage to the targeted area upon impact

abilities.name: Hyper-Velocity
abilities.text: Activate Hyper-Velocity state for swift forward flight

abilities.name: Hyper-Velocity (Armor Overdrive)
abilities.text: Activate Hyper-Velocity state for swift forward flight

abilities.name: Armor Overdrive
abilities.text: Activate Armor Overdrive state, enhancing the damage of Repulsor Blast and Unibeam

abilities.name: Micro-Missile Barrage
abilities.text: When Hyper-Velocity or Armor Overdrive is used, Iron Man can launch a missile bombardment

abilities.name: Micro-Missile Barrage (Armor Overdrive)
abilities.text: When Hyper-Velocity or Armor Overdrive is used, Iron Man can launch a missile bombardment

abilities.name: NANO TECH
abilities.text: When Iron Man, Ultron and Squirrel Girl team up, Ultron's Encephalo-Ray upgrades to Nano-Ray, firing a beam that pierces through all characters, dealing continuous damage to foes while healing allies; Squirrel Girl gains the Squirrel Missile ability. She directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion!

abilities.name: GAMMA CHARGE
abilities.text: Base Effect: Upgrade Armor Overdrive to Gamma Overdrive. In this state, Iron Man gains a Gamma Shield and can fire significantly stronger Repulsor Blasts and Unibeams. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, releasing Invincible Invincible Pulse Cannon generates a Gamma Shield and heavily infuses the blast, creating a Gamma Pulse Cannon. Its radiation creates a massive damage increase while the projectile flies

abilities.name: THUNDER OVERDRIVE
abilities.text: Base Effect: Enhance Unibeam both in and out of Armor Overdrive. When fired, a ring of volatile lightning energy forms, dealing bonus damage to enemies caught near the beam's edge. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor, Armor Overdrive cooldown is massively reduced.

abilities.name: Aqua Burst
abilities.text: Launch a high-speed water sphere that bursts upon impact, dealing damage to enemies within range

abilities.name: It's Jeff!
abilities.text: Deep dive into the scene and resurface to swallow both enemies and allies within range, activating Hide and Seek for a brief duration before ejecting the swallowed heroes forward

abilities.name: Hide and Seek
abilities.text: Dive into the scene with only his dorsal fin exposed, granting himself a Movement Boost. Jeff can heal while submerged and gains the wall-crawl ability

abilities.name: Healing Bubble
abilities.text: Spit a bubble that heals the ally who collects it, granting them Healing Boost and Movement Boost while also launching up nearby enemies

abilities.name: Oblivious Cuteness
abilities.text: Reduce damage taken from critical hits

abilities.name: IT'S JEFF-NADO!
abilities.text: When Storm activates Omega Hurricane and Jeff the Land Shark's It's Jeff is ready, they can unleash a powerful Team-Up Ability. During this period, Storm's Omega Hurricane merges with Jeff to form a Jeff-nado

abilities.name: GUARDIAN OF THE DEEP
abilities.text: Venom shares his symbiotes with Jeff and Hela. Jeff's Guardian of the Deep links with nearby allies, providing continuous healing. When the effect ends, it releases a powerful healing burst, converting any excess into Bonus Health.

abilities.name: New Friends
abilities.text: Jeff the Land Shark and Rocket Raccoon can ride on Groot's shoulders, receiving Damage Reduction

abilities.name: Jeff's Cuddle Buddy
abilities.text: Jeff the Land Shark and Rocket Raccoon can ride on Groot's shoulders, receiving Damage Reduction

abilities.name: MR. POOL'S INTERDIMENSIONAL TOY BOX
abilities.text: Base Effect: Gain a new ability to spit out a Deadpool Plushie. The plushie continuously Taunts nearby enemies while spraying a healing mist onto surrounding allies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Deadpool, the Deadpool Plushie asserts a much stronger Taunt while concurrently damaging enemies caught in its radius.

abilities.name: Energy Plasmoids
abilities.text: Fire lumikinetic explosive light blasts forward to heal friends and damage foes. Triggering a Sparkle Mark briefly boosts Attack Speed and enables firing without consuming energy

abilities.name: Blooming Ball
abilities.text: Launch a tracking orb of vampiric energy that damages enemies and heals allies in its radius. Striking the orb or hitting targets near it charges it up, increasing both its size and healing power. Press F to manually recall it.

abilities.name: Sparking Sprint
abilities.text: Wrap yourself in vampiric energy to gain a Speed Boost. While active, jump height and Attack Speed are increased, and Energy Blasts can be fired at no cost

abilities.name: Dazzling Detonation
abilities.text: Detonate a firework energy orb, dealing damage to enemies in the area and applying a Blind effect. The energy can also be transferred to an ally, granting them healing and a Speed Boost

abilities.name: Sparkle Mark
abilities.text: Hitting targets with Dazzling Detonation and Firework Finale applies a Sparkle Mark. Energy Plasmoids can detonate marks, granting allies a Healing Boost and Bonus Health, while dealing burst damage to enemies

abilities.name: Firework Finale
abilities.text: Charge up and unleash a massive ring of outward-flying firework clusters, Knocking Back nearby enemies. These clusters then orbit you, creating a field that damages enemies and heals allies. Expanding the cluster radius outward will Launch Up struck enemies

abilities.name: HELLFIRE SPARKS
abilities.text: Base Effect: When Attack Speed is enhanced, Energy Plasmoids transform into a hitscan attack that grants self-healing on hit and is capable of dealing critical hits. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the Void Magic Mark is never cleared, allowing her to indefinitely sustain the hitscan attack form.

abilities.name: VAMPIRIC KIN
abilities.text: Base Effect: Deploy a Vampiric Field. Allies standing within the field gain Life Steal when attacking enemies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Blade, allies inside the field receive an additional Continuous Healing effect.

abilities.name: Mystical Missile
abilities.text: Fire Mystical Missiles to heal allies or deal damage to enemies. Direct hits on allies provide extra healing

abilities.name: God of Mischief
abilities.text: Shapeshift into a targeted ally or enemy hero and use all their abilities except any of their Team-Up Abilities

abilities.name: Regeneration Domain
abilities.text: Use Rune Stones to create a magical field that provides allies Healing and converts incoming damage into further healing

abilities.name: Doppelganger
abilities.text: Project an Illusion that can cast some of Loki's abilities

abilities.name: Devious Exchange
abilities.text: Swap with the selected Illusion

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.text: Pull out a dagger to stab enemies, dealing extra damage when attacking an enemy from behind

abilities.name: Deception
abilities.text: Become Invisible and conjure an Illusion to deceive enemies

abilities.name: Deific Blessing
abilities.text: Mantis enhances Groot's wooden walls and Loki's Rune Stones with life energy. Groot can additionally unleash a Flower Wall, which, when in Flora Colossus state, restores health to random nearby allies and grants them Damage Reduction. Loki's Rune Stones grant allies within Regeneration Domain a Damage Boost

abilities.name: VILLAIN'S ILLUSION
abilities.text: Base Effect: Gain a new ability to target fallen heroes (friend or foe), letting Loki assume their form for a set time (cannot cast their Ultimate Ability). Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, Loki's transformation lasts slightly longer. Furthermore, taking lethal damage while transformed or in his Ultimate Ability state will merely revert him back to Loki with a sliver of Health, preventing a KO.

abilities.name: VIBRANT VITALITY
abilities.text: Base Effect: Gain a new ability to target fallen heroes (friend or foe), letting Loki assume their form for a set time (cannot cast their Ultimate Ability). Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, Loki's transformation lasts slightly longer. Furthermore, taking lethal damage while transformed or in his Ultimate Ability state will merely revert him back to Loki with a sliver of Health, preventing a KO

abilities.name: Light & Dark Ice
abilities.text: Fire ice shots that damage enemies or heal allies

abilities.name: Fate of Both Worlds
abilities.text: Take center stage and start dancing! Press to toggle between two performances: Heal allies or grant them Damage Boost

abilities.name: Ice Arts
abilities.text: Fire ice shards for a short duration, damaging enemies or healing allies while restoring her own Health

abilities.name: Share the Stage
abilities.text: Attach Idol Aura to an ally. Allies with Idol Aura also restore Health when Luna Snow is healing others

abilities.name: Absolute Zero
abilities.text: Cast a clump of ice to Freeze the hit enemy and restore Health

abilities.name: Cryo Heart
abilities.text: Automatically restore Health when casting Ice Arts or Absolute Zero

abilities.name: Smooth Skate
abilities.text: Keep moving forward to start ice skating and enable higher jumps

abilities.name: Number One Idol
abilities.text: Boost Healing. Gain extra healing when healing others

abilities.name: ICED OUT DIAMOND
abilities.text: Luna Snow grants Winter's Chill to Iron Fist and Emma Frost. When Iron Fist activates Harmony Recovery, he can heal nearby allies with Lunar Chi. Emma Frost can project ice energy forward, dealing damage and slowing enemies. She can also enhance her diamond form, condensing frost into an Absolute Zero Diamond barrier that blocks enemy attacks and movement

abilities.name: SPIRIT FOX ACCORD
abilities.text: White Fox grants Luna Snow a spirit fox for protection. Luna can activate it for a burst of speed and fire it forward, healing allies in its path while applying Charm to enemies

abilities.name: ATLAS BOND
abilities.text: Base Effect: Unleash a spirit fox forward that Charms enemies while healing any allies in its path. Activating the ability instantly cleanses all negative status effects on Luna Snow. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with White Fox, the spirit fox automatically returns after reaching its maximum distance, and the self-cleanse is retained.

abilities.name: DUALITY DANCE
abilities.text: Base Effect: Cast Soul Bond to tether all characters within range. Attacking tethered enemies or healing linked allies restores your Health. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, scoring critical hits with Light & Dark Ice reduces the cooldowns of Absolute Zero and Ice Arts.

abilities.name: Soulsword
abilities.text: Slash forward with the Soulsword

abilities.name: Darkchild
abilities.text: Transform into Darkchild, gaining enhancements to all her abilities

abilities.name: Stepping Discs
abilities.text: Jump through a Stepping Disc, teleporting a short distance in the direction of movement. Become Invincible while teleporting

abilities.name: Umbral Incursion
abilities.text: Dash forward and launch up enemies

abilities.name: Eldritch Whirl
abilities.text: Spin while swinging the Soulsword after exiting a Stepping Disc

abilities.name: Magik Slash
abilities.text: Strike forward an air slash

abilities.name: Demon's Rage
abilities.text: Summon a Limbo demon that attacks enemies after exiting a Stepping Disc

abilities.name: Limbo's Might
abilities.text: Convert damage inflicted on enemies into Bonus Health to herself

abilities.name: CHAIN OF CYTTORAK
abilities.text: Doctor Strange shares his arcane mastery with Scarlet Witch and Magik. Scarlet Witch's Chthonian Burst is replaced with Mystic Burst upon activation. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction. Magik can unleash a Chain of Cyttorak that links two enemies and slows them; the farther they are apart, the greater the Slow effect inflicted during the link

abilities.name: VOID PENTAGRAM
abilities.text: Base Effect: Casting Stepping Discs within an Hellish Magic Circle refunds energy, and each use of Stepping Discs summons a Limbo Demon. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the summoned Limbo Demons have heavily increased Health and a wider attack range.

abilities.name: Iron Volley
abilities.text: Fire a volley of magnetic orbs forward. The range of the resulting explosion increases based on distance flown

abilities.name: Meteor M
abilities.text: Draw in all materials around to forge an iron meteor that deals massive damage upon impact. Absorbing enemy projectiles can enhance the meteor's power, yet overloading will cause it to self-destruct

abilities.name: Metallic Curtain
