abilities.text: Change the magnetic field around to form a metallic curtain, blocking all incoming projectiles

abilities.name: Metal Bulwark
abilities.text: Conjure a metal shield around a chosen ally. Damage taken will transform into rings on Magneto's back

abilities.name: Iron Bulwark
abilities.text: Conjure an iron shield around himself. Damage taken will transform into rings on Magneto's back

abilities.name: Mag-Cannon
abilities.text: Convert the iron rings on Magneto's back into a Mag-Cannon and launch a metallic mass forward. Higher stacks of rings increase damage, and full stacks knock back enemies

abilities.name: ROYAL BLADE
abilities.text: Gambit charges Magneto's greatsword with kinetic energy. When Magneto activates this ability, Iron Volley is replaced with Ace Greatsword, which detonates upon striking enemies. The explosion leaves residual kinetic energy within the target, inflicting secondary damage after a brief delay

abilities.name: METALLIC CHAOS
abilities.text: Base Effect: Summons a Chaos Greatsword that deals damage to enemies in front. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Scarlet Witch, Magnetic Cannon becomes a charged ability. Charging consumes passive energy, and each energy segment consumed fires a Chaos Greatsword that deals damage to enemies.

abilities.name: MAGNETIC RESONANCE
abilities.text: Base Effect: Cast a magnetic projection that mimics Magneto's movement and ability casts perfectly from the enemy's perspective. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Emma Frost, the magnetic projection receives a massive Health bump and will persist indefinitely unless destroyed or manually recalled.

abilities.name: Life Energy Blast
abilities.text: Fire an energy thorn and regain one Life Orb after a critical hit.

abilities.name: Soul Resurgence
abilities.text: Release energy around her while moving, providing Healing Over Time and Movement Boosts for surrounding allies. Excess healing converts to Bonus Health

abilities.name: Spore Slumber
abilities.text: Throw a spore to Sedate the nearest enemy

abilities.name: Allied Inspiration
abilities.text: Consume Life Orbs to grant allies a Damage Boost

abilities.name: Natural Anger
abilities.text: Consume Life Orbs to grant herself a Damage Boost

abilities.name: Healing Flower
abilities.text: Consume Life Orbs to grant allies Healing Over Time

abilities.name: Nature's Favor
abilities.text: Receive a Movement Boost when not injured and Healing Over Time when consuming Life Orbs

abilities.name: Heavenly Guardian
abilities.text: Mantis enhances Groot's wooden walls and Loki's Rune Stones with life energy. Groot can additionally unleash a Flower Wall, which, when in Flora Colossus state, restores health to random nearby allies and grants them Damage Reduction. Loki's Rune Stones grant allies within Regeneration Domain a Damage Boost

abilities.name: STAR BLOSSOM
abilities.text: Base Effect: Recasting Healing Flower on a teammate with the effect enhances and spreads the healing aura. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, using Healing Flower on any teammate instantly triggers the enhanced Spell Field and healing effect.

abilities.name: VITALITY PACT
abilities.text: Base Effect: Upon defeat, Mantis can freely move as a soul, healing nearby allies, and reforge her body at a chosen spot. After using Natural Anger, the effect of Nature's Favor is enhanced, increasing the amount of healing provided. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, her soul state can forge Soul Bond with nearby teammates, granting Healing Over Timeand distributing damage taken across the bond.

abilities.name: Stretch Punch
abilities.text: Stretch out a forward punch to attack enemies

abilities.name: Distended Grip
abilities.text: Extend arms forward to entangle an enemy, then press Primary Attack to pull the hit enemy toward him, or select and yank another enemy, Knocking Them Airborne against each other. Hit targets are Immobilized

abilities.name: Flexible Elongation
abilities.text: Gain a Shield, select a target and dash towards them, dealing damage to enemies or granting a Shield to allies

abilities.name: Reflexive Rubber
abilities.text: Stretch the body to absorb damage before launching stored damage in the targeted direction

abilities.name: Brainiac Bounce
abilities.text: Leap upward and smash the ground, slowing enemies within range. Mister Fantastic can leap again upon landing a hit

abilities.name: Elastic Strength
abilities.text: Using abilities generates Elasticity, boosting attack power. Reaching full Elasticity triggers an Inflated state that increases Maximum Health, further boosts damage, and enables the use of Reflexive Rubber

abilities.name: FANTASTIC AMPLIFIER
abilities.text: Rocket Raccoon upgrades his B.R.B. for Star-Lord and Mister Fantastic. Star-Lord gets an Astral Jump device, allowing him to teleport to its deployment point from anywhere on the map. Mister Fantastic receives a Fantastic Amplifier, removing his Elasticity limit and letting him actively enter Inflation state

abilities.name: CLOBBERIN' RESEARCH DEPT.
abilities.text: Base Effect: In brawler stance, Stretch Punch becomes a charged ability, firing a forward Brawling Punch. Hitting an enemy grants Bonus Health scaling with damage, and a full charge Launches hit enemies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Thing, while in the brawling stance, Distended Grip also becomes a charged ability, slamming down a Distended Hammer. Hitting enemies grants Bonus Health based on damage, and Launches enemies at full charge.

abilities.name: Crescent Dart
abilities.text: Unleash Crescent Darts forward that can bounce between enemies and Ankhs, dealing damage to enemies

abilities.name: Hand of Khonshu
abilities.text: Open a portal that allows Khonshu to bombard enemies with his talons

abilities.name: Ancient Ankh
abilities.text: Fire an Ankh to launch up enemies within its radius towards the center

abilities.name: Moonlight Hook
abilities.text: Launch a frontal grappling hook that pulls Moon Knight towards it

abilities.name: Moon Blade
abilities.text: Launch forward a Moon Blade that can bounce between enemies and Ankhs, dealing damage to enemies

abilities.name: Triple Eclipse
abilities.text: Perform a combo with his truncheon, and the third strike will launch up the enemy hit slightly

abilities.name: MOON GOD'S CHOSEN
abilities.text: Blessed by Khonshu, Blade gains a new ability. When activated, Blade swings his Ancestral Sword in a powerful slash, dashing forward a short distance. At the end of the dash, he swiftly slashes four times, each strike sending a Darkmoon Blade forward. When a Darkmoon Blade hits an enemy, it bounces to nearby targets

abilities.name: LUMINOUS MOON
abilities.text: Base Effect: Enter Phased state and dash forward. Upon concluding, emit a Light Energy Healing Wave that heals Moon Knight and nearby allies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, the Phased state duration is extended, the dash distance increases, and the Light Energy Healing Wave boasts a larger radius and stronger healing output.

abilities.name: BLOOD MOON
abilities.text: Base Effect: Deploy an Ankh Trap. Upon triggering, an Ankh materializes at the location, while summoning a single Talon of Khonshu to Launch enemies toward the trap's center. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Elsa Bloodstone, triggering the trap summons multiple Talons of Khonshu to bombard the area.

abilities.name: Trident of Neptune
abilities.text: Throw the trident forward, reducing Aquatic Dominion's cooldown upon enemy impact. Critical hits cause Monstro Spawn to enter a berserk state, gaining increased Attack Speed

abilities.name: Horn of Proteus
abilities.text: Summon Giganto to leap atop enemies within range, disabling their mobility abilities

abilities.name: Blessing of the Deep
abilities.text: Summon a protective barrier while flying upwards

abilities.name: Aquatic Dominion
abilities.text: Summon a Monstro Spawn that can autonomously attack enemies

abilities.name: Wrath of the Seven Seas
abilities.text: Launch the trident forward to damage nearby enemies, then direct all Monstro Spawn to perform an enhanced attack on the nearest hit enemy. When the trident hits an enemy, Monstro Spawn to enter a berserk state, gaining increased Attack Speed

abilities.name: TIDAL DIRGE
abilities.text: Hela channels energy of the undead to empower Namor. When Namor strikes with his trident, a spectral water column erupts at the target area, slowing enemies hit. Whenever Hela or Namor assist in a KO, an invulnerable Undead Monstro spawns at the fallen enemy's position, automatically attacking the nearest foe for a short time before vanishing

abilities.name: GAMMA MONSTRO
abilities.text: Base Effect: Summon an extra Gamma Monstro that continuously damages the nearest enemy. Upon landing critical hits, the Gamma Monstro gains increased Attack Speed. Hitting an enemy with Wrath of the Seven Seas prompts it to fire a powerful beam. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, casting Blessing of the Deep creates a water barrier infused with Gamma energy. Standing inside accelerates the Gamma Monstro cooldown and grants it a Damage Boost.

abilities.name: CHILLING CHARISMA
abilities.text: Base Effect: Gain a new ability to summon a Frost Tide forward. The wave damages, Pushes Back, and inflicts a Slow on all enemies hit. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Luna Snow, the Frost Tide gains 1 charge and crashes down upon reaching its maximum range, dealing area damage and Slowing enemies caught near the endpoint.

abilities.name: Cyber-Web Cluster
abilities.text: Launch forward a Cyber-Web Cluster

abilities.name: Spider-Sweeper
abilities.text: Enhance the SP//dr suit, launching up enemies in its path and deploying Arachno-Mines, Spider-Drones, and Cyber-Webs repeatedly

abilities.name: Bionic Spider-Nest
abilities.text: Generate a Bionic Spider-Nest at a targeted area, periodically spawning Spider-Drones and creating Cyber-Webs. While in the Cyber-Web, Peni and allies gain Healing Over Time and a Movement Boost. Excess healing converts into Bonus Health. Spider-Drones inflict a Slow effect on hit, which can stack and refresh its effect period with multiple hits

abilities.name: Arachno-Mine
abilities.text: Deploy Arachno-Mines that can be concealed within the confines of a Cyber-Web

abilities.name: Cyber-Bond
abilities.text: Shoot a web strand that links to the targeted area or Cyber-Web. If stretched too far, it will trigger a pullback

abilities.name: Wall Crawl
abilities.text: HOLD Jump to crawl on vertical surfaces

abilities.name: Cyber-Web Snare
abilities.text: Cast futuristic webbing that Immobilizes enemies or creates a Cyber-Web. While in the Cyber-Web, Peni and allies gain Healing Over Time and a Movement Boost. Excess healing converts into Bonus Health

abilities.name: ARMORIZED SPIDER-NEST
abilities.text: Enhanced by Rocket Raccoon, Peni Parker's Bionic Spider-Nest regularly generates strengthened armor packs. Each armor pack grants bonus health to the hero who picks up the pack. Peni Parker can deploy Bionic Spider-Nest and Armored Spider-Nest at the same time

abilities.name: Cyber-Spiders
abilities.text: Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging a Web-Cluster shot and granting Bonus Health

abilities.name: VIBRANIUM MECH
abilities.text: Base Effect: Upon activation, briefly grants Cyber-Web Clusteran Attack Speedand DamageBoost. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Panther, activating the ability deploys a frontal Vibranium Shield, while reducing the Vibranium Energy cost of Cyber-Web Cluster.

abilities.name: ROCKET NETWORK
abilities.text: Base Effect: Deploy an Armored Spider-Nestthat periodically drops Spider-Dronesand Armor Packsthat grant Bonus Health. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, the Armored Spider-Nestpassively regenerates its own Health. Furthermore, Rocket's B.R.B.will generate Cyber-Webs, and spawn both Spider-Dronesand Arachno-Mines.

abilities.name: Cosmic Flames
abilities.text: Launch a fiery projectile forward, applying 1 Spark to enemies hit. Critical hits apply 2 Sparks. At 3 Sparks, Phoenix triggers a fiery explosion that applies 1 Spark to enemies around and Healing Over Time to self. Sparks from explosions will not stack within a brief period

abilities.name: Telekinesis Burst
abilities.text: Mark a targeted area with psionic energy, followed by a series of fiery explosions. The first blast Stuns enemies, while the subsequent two explosions inflict Slow. Applies 1 Spark to enemies hit

abilities.name: Dark Ascent
abilities.text: Merge with the Phoenix, entering a state of free flight. Gain a Movement Boost

abilities.name: Telepathic Illusion
abilities.text: Leave behind an illusion and instantly teleport in the desired direction, followed by detonating the illusion. Enemies hit are applied with 1 Spark

abilities.name: Endsong Inferno
abilities.text: Soar into the sky with the Phoenix and crash down onto a selected area, dealing devastating damage to enemies while creating a shockwave that destroys enemy summons, shields, and any Bonus Health. Enemies hit are applied with 1 Spark

abilities.name: Mind's Grace
abilities.text: Jean Grey imbues Wolverine with the awe-inspiring Phoenix Force

abilities.name: CIRCLE OF LIFE
abilities.text: Base Effect: Psionic Detonation is replaced by Phoenix Netherfire, applying a Telekinetic Mark to the targeted location. Upon hitting, it triggers an initial small explosion that briefly Stuns enemies, followed by two larger explosions that apply a Healing Reduction effect. Every single blast inflicts Sparks onto the enemies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, every blast in the sequence applies multiple stacks of Sparks to enemies caught within.

abilities.name: TELEKINETIC BEATDOWN
abilities.text: Base Effect: Fire a telekinetic shockwave forward. If it lands, the Phoenix Force rushes the enemy and delivers a powerful punch. If there are other targets nearby, the Phoenix Force rapidly blinks between them to strike them as well, inflicting Sparks on each victim while healing Phoenix. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rogue, the width of the telekinetic shockwave expands, and the Phoenix Force's target detection range is increased.

abilities.name: Psionic Crossbow
abilities.text: Unleash bolts with psionic crossbows to damage enemies and reduce the cooldowns of all her abilities

abilities.name: Dance of the Butterfly
abilities.text: Slash nearby enemies with a psionic katana, dealing massive damage

abilities.name: Psi-Blade Dash
abilities.text: Dash forward and slice through enemies along the path with psionic blades

abilities.name: Psychic Stealth
abilities.text: Enter stealth and gain a Movement Boost

abilities.name: Wing Shurikens
abilities.text: Launch a volley of psionic shurikens that stick to enemies, dealing damage and granting herself Bonus Health. Press again to recall the shurikens

abilities.name: LIGHT & DARK DARTS
abilities.text: Cloak & Dagger share light and dark energy with Hawkeye and Psylocke. When Hawkeye uses Crescent Slash, he also releases a blade wave that heals and boosts healing for teammates, while inflicting damage and Vulnerability on enemies. Psylocke can launch a Light Boomerang Dart that heals allies, harms enemies, and provides her with temporary healing upon return. She can also unleash a ring of Dark Darts that slow enemies while she briefly enters a Phased state

abilities.name: MENTAL PROJECTION
abilities.text: Base Effect: Create an illusory projection that automatically dashes forward to use Psi-Blade Dash, while Psylocke enters Stealth. If Psylocke attacks, the illusion mimics her strikes. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Emma Frost, Psylocke's mental powers are elevated, allowing her to reactivate the ability to instantly swap places with her illusion.

abilities.name: Bombard Mode
abilities.text: Fire energy projectiles that deal damage

abilities.name: Repair Mode
abilities.text: Shoot bouncing spheres to heal allies

abilities.name: C.Y.A.
abilities.text: Deploy a Cosmic Yarn Amplifier that grants allies a Damage Boost

abilities.name: B.R.B.
abilities.text: Deploy a Battle Rebirth Beacon that revives a fallen ally and periodically produces armor packs and rocket jet packs

abilities.name: Wild Crawl
abilities.text: Hold Space to run on a wall

abilities.name: Old Friends
abilities.text: Jeff the Land Shark and Rocket Raccoon can ride on Groot's shoulders, receiving Damage Reduction

abilities.name: MAMMALIAN BOND
abilities.text: Base Effect: Tosses out a scattered batch of augmented Vitality Acorns. Acorns that hit the floor can be collected. Whether struck directly or picked up, teammates receive a burst of healing and global cooldown reduction. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Squirrel Girl, the maximum charge count for this ability is increased.

abilities.name: PLANET X PALS
abilities.text: Base Effect: Converts Bombard Mode to launch Thorny Spores. Upon impact, they deal continuous damage to enemies within the radius while healing and granting Bonus Health to allies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Groot, Rocket can ride on Groot's shoulders, and the active duration of the Thorny Spores field is extended.

abilities.name: Power Surge Punch
abilities.text: Punch forward with both fists

abilities.name: Defensive Stance
abilities.text: Absorb nearby projectiles and reduce incoming damage; absorbed damage powers up your next Southern Brawl

abilities.name: Southern Brawl
abilities.text: While in Defensive Stance, dash forward and slam enemies in front, dealing area damage

abilities.name: Chrono Kick Combo
abilities.text: Dash forward and launch the enemy, entering flight; activate again to Knock Down nearby enemies. Your next two Power Surge Punch attacks become ranged, piercing enemies and granting Bonus Health

abilities.name: Fatal Attraction
abilities.text: Dash forward. Press again to unleash a burst of Chronovium Power, dealing continuous damage to nearby foes; after a delay, the energy retracts, pulling all enemies towards Rogue

abilities.name: Ability Absorption
abilities.text: Dash forward to knock down your target and absorb their energy; after absorbing, replace Ability Absorption with one of their abilities or refresh Fatal Attraction. Also absorb Health and stats based on their role

abilities.name: Heartbreaker
abilities.text: Continuously absorb Ultimate Ability Energy from nearby enemies and steal stats based on their role

abilities.name: HEARTS AS ONE
abilities.text: Gambit shares kinetic energy with Magneto and Rogue. When Magneto activates this ability, Iron Volley is replaced with Ace Greatsword, which detonates upon striking enemies. The explosion leaves residual kinetic energy within the target, inflicting secondary damage after a brief delay. When Rogue activates the ability, each of her attacks causes a kinetic explosion that damages nearby enemies and heals nearby allies

abilities.name: MR. & MRS. X
abilities.text: Base Effect: After activation, every attack triggers a kinetic explosion, dealing area damage to surrounding enemies while simultaneously healing nearby allies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, Rogue remains permanently locked in the "Hearts as One" state.

abilities.name: EXPLOSIVE ENTANGLEMENT
abilities.text: Base Effect: Defensive Stance is fortified. Activating the ability expands a magnetic field, drastically boosting the Damage Reduction ratio of Defensive Stance. Furthermore, all damage absorbed by the field is converted directly into damage for Southern Brawl. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, Southern Brawl Knocks back enemies. Extra damage is dealt if they're propelled into a wall.

abilities.name: Chaos Control
abilities.text: Unleash Chaos Magic on enemies to deal damage and restore Chaos Energy. Concurrently damages any enemies within range bearing a Chaos Magic mark

abilities.name: Reality Erasure
abilities.text: Engage in free-flight while gaining Bonus Health and charging energy. While flying, continuously pull in nearby enemies and inflict Chaos Marks, dealing gradually increasing damage over time. Then, unleash the charged energy to deal massive area damage. Small chance to be immune to incoming damage from enemies within the ultimate's attack range

abilities.name: Mystic Projection
abilities.text: Enter the Phased state for free-flight. Press again to exit early

abilities.name: Dark Seal
abilities.text: Land a hit on a target or the scene, or press {Ability1} again to generate a Force Field. The initial explosion Stuns enemies within range, while continuing to apply a Slow effect for the remaining duration. Continuously inflicts Chaos Marks on enemies within range

abilities.name: Chthonian Burst
abilities.text: Consume Chaos Energy to fire explosive magic missiles, damaging enemies

abilities.name: SCARLET HEX
abilities.text: Unleash a shockwave of Chaos Magic forward, dealing damage and applying a Chaos Magic mark to enemies

abilities.name: CHAOS MARK
abilities.text: While the mark is active, using Chaos Control deals damage to marked enemies. Dealing damage to enemies with a Chaos Mark grants Bonus Health

abilities.name: Sorcery Surge
abilities.text: Doctor Strange shares his arcane mastery, replacing Scarlet Witch's Chthonian Burst with Mystic Burst upon activation. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction

abilities.name: SORCERERS SUPREME
abilities.text: Base Effect: Chthonian Burst is replaced with Mystic Burst upon activation. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Doctor Strange, Scarlet Witch's maximum total Chaos Energy pool increases, and Chaos Control generates energy much faster when attacking.

abilities.name: HEX FIREWORKS
abilities.text: Base Effect: Infuse firework energy into the Dark Seal forcefield, turning it into a Plasmoid Seal, allowing for a secondary blast. After expanding the Plasmoid Seal, pressing the {Ability1} key again while it persists will detonate the fireworks, dealing damage and inflicting Vulnerability. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, Scarlet Witch receives constant healing from the firework energy while using Mystic Projection.

abilities.name: Spider-Power
abilities.text: Swing fists forward to strike, dealing extra damage to the enemy with a Spider-Tracer

abilities.name: Web-Cluster
abilities.text: Shoot a Web-Cluster that deals damage and attaches a Spider-Tracer to the hit enemy

abilities.name: Spectacular Spin
abilities.text: Launch Web-Clusters all around to damage and Stun enemies

abilities.name: Web-Swing
abilities.text: Shoot a strand of webbing to swing.

abilities.name: Get Over Here!
abilities.text: Shoot webbing to reel in the hit enemy. If the enemy is tagged with a Spider-Tracer, Spider-Man will get pulled to them instead

abilities.name: Amazing Combo
abilities.text: Launch an enemy upward, dealing extra damage to the enemy with a Spider-Tracer

abilities.name: Spider-Sense
abilities.text: Give a warning of enemies that have been around

abilities.name: Wall Crawl
abilities.text: Press Space to wall crawl, and while crawling, left-click to sprint

abilities.name: Inferno Blast
abilities.text: Human Torch stores Pyrokinetic Energy in Spider-Man's suit, enabling him to unleash an Inferno Blast that sprays a fiery web while performing a backflip to create distance. The flames damage enemies and apply a Burn-Tracer. Detonating these Burn-Tracers inflicts Damage Over Time

abilities.name: Sticky Spider-Bomb
abilities.text: Cyber-Spiders Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging a Web-Cluster shot and granting Bonus Health

abilities.name: SYMBIOTE BOND
abilities.text: Base Effect: Venom shares a part of his symbiote with Spider-Man, activating their symbiote abilities. Spider-Man can convert the symbiotes into explosive spikes that inflict harm on nearby enemies and relentlessly drive them back. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, this triggers additional Touch of Klyntar tendrils that continuously tether and damage enemies on top of the base effect.

abilities.name: PARKER POWER-UP
abilities.text: Base Effect: Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Spider-Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging all Web-Cluster shots. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Peni Parker, Spider-Tracers applied by Web-Cluster are upgraded. Detonating these upgraded marks generates <Buff>Bonus Health for Spider-Man.

abilities.name: Burst Acorn
abilities.text: Shoot bouncing Burst Acorns

abilities.name: Unbeatable Squirrel Tsunami
abilities.text: Summon a horde of squirrels to charge forward, dealing damage while bouncing against structures

abilities.name: Tail Bounce
abilities.text: Rocket upwards with a bounce of her tail

abilities.name: Mammal Bond
abilities.text: Reload Burst Acorns and can use an ability without cooldown once in a short duration

abilities.name: Squirrel Blockade
abilities.text: Launch an acorn to unleash Squirrel Guards, Imprisoning the first hit enemy

abilities.name: Squirrel Missile
abilities.text: When Iron Man, Ultron and Squirrel Girl team up, Ultron's Encephalo-Ray upgrades to Nano-Ray, firing a beam that pierces through all characters, dealing continuous damage to foes while healing allies; Squirrel Girl gains the Squirrel Missile ability. She directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion!

abilities.name: SQUIRREL MISSILE
abilities.text: Base Effect: Squirrel Girl gains the Squirrel Missile ability. She directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Man, using Squirrel Blockade simultaneously fires a Squirrel Missile.

abilities.name: ESU ALUMNUS
abilities.text: Base Effect: Spider-Man gives Squirrel Girl a web bomb. She can launch it to unleash an explosion upon contact with the environment or an enemy, briefly Slowing and damaging enemies caught in the blast. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Spider-Man, Squirrel Girl receives more Web Fluid. After throwing Webbed Acorn, viscous web fluid coats the ground alongside the explosion, leaving behind a sticky Web Area. Enemies within suffer a continuous Slow that scales into a Stun if they linger too long.

abilities.name: Element Guns
abilities.text: Shoot enemies with dual Element Guns

abilities.name: Galactic Legend
abilities.text: Engage in free-flight and lock onto enemies in sight

abilities.name: Rocket Propulsion
abilities.text: Consume energy to gain a Movement Boost and soar forward

abilities.name: Blaster Barrage
abilities.text: Fire a frenzy of shots, causing damage to enemies within range.

abilities.name: Stellar Shift
abilities.text: Dodge in the direction of movement and swiftly reload

abilities.name: Astral Jump
abilities.text: Star-Lord gets a teleport to its deployment point from anywhere on the map

abilities.name: FLORA MUNITIONS
abilities.text: Gain a new ability to toss Twisted Thorn Seeds forward. Upon landing, they rapidly Sprout and take root, generating Thorn Snares around the area. Enemies stepping on a snare take damage and suffer a Root effect. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Groot, the number of Thorn Snares deployed increases, and the damage dealt when an enemy steps on them is boosted.

abilities.name: STAR-SOUL
abilities.text: Base Effect: Gain a new ability to place a Telekinetic Beacon. You can teleport back to the location where the beacon is deployed from anywhere on the map. Upon defeat, Star-Lord will cocoon and respawn at the Telekinetic Beacon's coordinates. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, every time Star-Lord participates in a KO, Telekinetic Beaconcooldown is reduced.

abilities.name: Wind Blade
abilities.text: Launch forward-piercing Wind Blades

abilities.name: Omega Hurricane
abilities.text: Transform into a hurricane to draw in nearby enemies and deal damage

abilities.name: Weather Control
abilities.text: Switch the weather to empower allies: Tornado grants a Movement Boost; Thunder grants a Damage Boost

abilities.name: Goddess Boost
abilities.text: Channel the power of the weather to empower Storm: Tornado grants a Movement Boost and inflicts Slow on enemies; Thunder grants a Damage Boost and summons lightning to inflict damage

abilities.name: Bolt Rush
abilities.text: Unleash a lightning bolt forward

abilities.name: ETERNAL WEATHER WITCH
abilities.text: Storm channels her elemental power into Adam Warlock. When Adam uses Soaring Surge, his movement speed is increased. While flying, Adam leaves behind a storm-charged trail that heals and speeds up allies within it

abilities.name: GOD OF THUNDER
abilities.text: Base Effect: Upgrade Wind Blade into a hitscan beam that detonates upon striking a target. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor, Bolt Rush becomes Chain Lightning, allowing it to bounce from foe to foe

abilities.name: JAWS OF FATE
abilities.text: Base Effect: Unleash a torrential downpour that continuously heals both herself and her teammates. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, casting Omega Hurricane allows Jeff to swim inside the cyclone, generating a localized Jeff-nado.

abilities.name: Accursed Pistols
abilities.text: Shoot forward dual-wielded pistols. Gain increased Attack Speed when Demonic Energy exceeds 50%

abilities.name: Leaded Transformation
abilities.text: Enter Half-Demon State, transforming your arms into demonic rifles to unleash a rain of lead. These rifles have increased Attack Speed and Infinite Ammo. Every bullet that strikes an enemy triggers Lifesteal

abilities.name: Mantle of Oblivion
abilities.text: Spread your cloak to form a spherical barrier, blocking incoming enemy attacks. When Demonic Energy exceeds 50%, the radius of the sphere expands further.

abilities.name: Abyssal Veil
abilities.text: Throw a dark magic sphere that generates a Veil upon landing. Accursed Pistols shots passing through it generate more Demonic Energy and bullets from Leaded Transformation gain increased Lifesteal. Enemy projectiles passing through suffer reduced damage and healing output. Enemies who pass through the Veil take damage and are Blinded

abilities.name: Void Walk
abilities.text: Enter the Void for free-flight. Upon reappearing, gain a decaying Movement Boost and damage surrounding enemies

abilities.name: Ruinous Pact
abilities.text: Accumulate Demonic Energy by dealing damage via Accursed Pistols, blocking attacks with Mantle of Oblivion, or by using Void Walk. Reaching full energy automatically triggers the Half-Demon State

abilities.name: Demon of the End
abilities.text: Enter Full Demon State. Fire up to 6 high-powered shots that pierce through enemies and barriers, with the final shot being the most powerful. Hitting enemies grants Bonus Health to yourself and nearby allies

abilities.name: Chaos Collision
abilities.text: Base Effect: Gain a New Ability. Create an arcane zone that continuously damages enemies and applies stacking Damage and Healing Reduction. Reactivate to teleport to the zone's center. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Scarlet Witch, after teleporting, unleash a magical shockwave, dealing one-time damage to nearby enemies while launching them towards The Hood

abilities.name: New Moon's Shadow
abilities.text: Base Effect: Enhances Abyssal Veil into a Lunar Barrier that blocks projectiles. Upon breaking, it detonates, damaging enemies and applying Damage and Healing Reduction. Enemies passing through take damage and are briefly Blinded. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Moon Knight, the Lunar Barrier has greater shield value, and The Hood's attacks that pass through it gain a bounce effect

abilities.name: Adjudication
abilities.text: Fire at enemies with Adjudication, his Automatic Rifle

abilities.name: Deliverance
abilities.text: Fire at enemies with Deliverance, his Shotgun

abilities.name: Final Judgement
abilities.text: Unleash two Gatling guns and missiles to attack enemies

abilities.name: Vantage Connection
abilities.text: Launch a hook to generate a cable that enables the Punisher to move rapidly by pressing F

abilities.name: Culling Turret
abilities.text: Deploy a Culling Turret that grounds Punisher and blocks damage from the front while dealing massive damage

abilities.name: Scourge Grenade
abilities.text: Throw a smoke grenade forward to obscure enemy vision and leap backward

abilities.name: Warrior's Gaze
abilities.text: Retain vision of enemies that disappear from view for a short duration

abilities.name: CUTTING-EDGE TECH
abilities.text: The Punisher upgrades Black Widow's arsenal, adding a Pulse Mode to her Red Room Rifle. While the ability is active, using Straight Shooter fires a pulse beam that deals piercing damage

abilities.name: JUSTICE SENSE
abilities.text: Daredevil shares the location of his Sonic Pursuit target with The Punisher. At the same time, The Punisher can launch a devil-infused shock grenade to damage and blind enemies

abilities.name: Ancient Judgement
abilities.text: The Punisher rides atop Devil Dinosaur, restricting him to only Adjudication/Deliverance and Scourge Grenade while disabling other abilities. While mounted, Devil Dinosaur absorbs a portion of all damage inflicted on The Punisher

abilities.name: BESTIAL HUNT
abilities.text: Base Effect: Shoot piercing bullets that carry a Damage Boost effect. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Daredevil, the bullets break enemy summoned walls and shields more quickly.

abilities.name: AMMO OVERLOAD
abilities.text: Base Effect: Throw an Ammo Overload Device in the target direction. Upon entering the device's range, receive Faster Firing. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, the device grants Infinite Ammo.

abilities.name: Stone Haymaker
abilities.text: Deliver a devastating Heavy Blow. Can Knock Down flying enemies.

abilities.name: Yancy Street Charge
abilities.text: Continuously charge forward, launching up enemies and leaving behind a zone at the final position that prevents the use of mobility abilities

abilities.name: Embattled Leap
abilities.text: Jump toward an ally and apply damage reduction to yourself and allies within the landing area

abilities.name: Battle Blitz
abilities.text: Jump toward an enemy and apply Vulnerability to enemies within the landing area

abilities.name: Clobberin' Time
abilities.text: Use immense power to launch up all enemies in front of the Thing into the air

abilities.name: Unyielding Will
abilities.text: Immune to launch-up, knock-back, and other displacement effects

abilities.name: Cosmic Fastball
abilities.text: Wolverine and The Thing can interact with each other. Once both parties confirm, The Thing can lift Wolverine and press the key to hurl him forward

abilities.name: GAMMA CHARGE
abilities.text: Hulk charges Black Panther and The Thing with gamma radiation. When Black Panther's health is low, he gains a gamma shield, becoming Unstoppable and blocking attacks. The Thing gains Gamma Gauntlets, boosting Damage and range of his Rocky Jab and Stone Haymaker. Dealing damage with these attacks grants Bonus Health, and maximum Bonus Health cap is increased

abilities.name: Flying Thing
abilities.text: Human Torch can lift The Thing into the air and slam him down, dealing damage, launching enemies, and creating a zone that disables mobility abilities

abilities.name: TWO IN ONE
abilities.text: Base Effect: Enter an enhanced state upon activation. For the duration, The Thing's fists are violently engulfed in flames. Every Rocky Jab deals splash damage, and every Stone Haymaker creates an explosion, dealing damage in a frontal cone. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Human Torch, Human Torch can lift The Thing into the air and slam him down, dealing damage and Stun to enemies. The Thing then automatically enters his flaming enhanced state upon landing.

abilities.name: UNBREAKABLE FORCES
abilities.text: Base Effect: Generate a layer of Psionic Armor upon activation, granting Bonus Health scaling off currently missing Health. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up Invisible Woman, the Psionic Armor is fortified. While active, every time The Thing takes a set amount of damage, the armor pulses out a wave of area healing for allies. Furthermore, the conversion ratio for missing Health into Bonus Health is increased.

abilities.name: Mjolnir Bash
abilities.text: Wield Mjolnir to strike enemies. When Awakened, Thor can launch lightning arc waves to deal damage

abilities.name: God of Thunder
abilities.text: Soar upwards and smite the ground after charging for a duration, inflicting damage on enemies within range

abilities.name: Storm Surge
abilities.text: Hold to spin Mjolnir before dashing forward and knocking back enemies

abilities.name: Lightning Realm
abilities.text: Summon lightning that restores Thorforce based on the number of hit enemies

abilities.name: Awakening Rune
abilities.text: Consume Thorforce to enter the Awakened state, granting Bonus Health and enhancing Mjolnir Bash

abilities.name: Hammer Throw
abilities.text: Throw Mjolnir forward which then returns

abilities.name: Thorforce
abilities.text: Consume Thorforce to gain Bonus Health. Landing Mjolnir Bash on an enemy instantly recharges Thorforce

abilities.name: THUNDERSTRIKE PIKE
abilities.text: Angela shares fragments of her Ichors with Thor, empowering him to hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor can leap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range

abilities.name: RAGNAROK REBIRTH
abilities.text: Base Effect: Receiving fatal damage prevents immediate defeat, Thor gains a decaying pool of Bonus Health. If he participates in a KO during this time, he resurrects and recovers a small amount of Health. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, if either of them participates in a KO, Thor instantly revives, restoring Health equal to his remaining Bonus Health and gaining a Continuous Healing effect.

abilities.name: DIVINE ARMORY
abilities.text: Base Effect: Hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor canleap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Angela, leaping to the Thunder Spear grants Bonus Health.

abilities.name: ENCEPHALO-RAY
abilities.text: Unleash a burning energy beam

abilities.name: IMPERATIVE: FIREWALL
abilities.text: Deploy drones to an ally marked by Imperative: Patch, granting them increased Speed and Damage. Additionally, all allies within range of you and the chosen teammate receive Bonus Health.

abilities.name: IMPERATIVE: PATCH
abilities.text: Command up to 2 giant drones to follow 2 allies, constantly healing allies within its radius, with more healing for the designated allies.

abilities.name: DYNAMIC FLIGHT
abilities.text: Fly quickly in the direction of movement and then enter an Accelerated state

abilities.name: RAGE OF ULTRON
abilities.text: Summon Ultron Drones to fire Encephalo-Rays, damaging enemies or healing allies

abilities.name: NANO RAY
abilities.text: When Iron Man, Ultron and Squirrel Girl team up, Ultron's Encephalo-Ray upgrades to Nano-Ray, firing a beam that pierces through all characters, dealing continuous damage to foes while healing allies; Squirrel Girl gains the Squirrel Missile ability. She directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion!

abilities.name: STARK PROTOCOL
abilities.text: Base Effect: Upgrade Encephalo-Ray to Nano-Ray, firing multiple damaging nano-projectiles forward. Enhanced Effect:When teaming up with Iron Man, Imperative: Firewall fires powerful homing missiles at enemies in range, causing area damage.

abilities.name: SP//DR SYNC
abilities.text: Base Effect: Apply Imperative: Patch to all allies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Peni Parker, Imperative: Firewall applies to all Drones, allowing the ability effects to be triggered multiple times simultaneously.

abilities.name: Dark Predation
abilities.text: Unleash tentacles forward to attack enemies

abilities.name: Feast of the Abyss
abilities.text: Burrow underground for free movement. After a duration or by left-clicking, devour enemies above to deal damage based on the enemy's current health and generate equivalent Bonus Health. Devoured enemies suffer Reduced Healing

abilities.name: Venom Swing
abilities.text: Launch webbing forward, allowing for a singular swing in the desired direction

abilities.name: Symbiotic Resilience
abilities.text: Generate Bonus Health against damage. The lower Venom's Health, the greater the Bonus Health generated

abilities.name: Frenzied Arrival
abilities.text: Dash to the target location from a certain height. Upon landing, damage nearby enemies, launching them up toward the landing point

abilities.name: Cellular Corrosion
abilities.text: Unleash tentacles to Slow enemies within reach. Enemies unable to break free in time will suffer damage

abilities.name: Alien Biology
abilities.text: Press Space to wall crawl, and while crawling, left-click to sprint

abilities.name: HEALING TENDRILS
abilities.text: Venom shares his symbiotes with Jeff and Hela. Jeff's Guardian of the Deep links with nearby allies, providing continuous healing. When the effect ends, it releases a powerful healing burst, converting any excess into Bonus Health. Hela's Hel Tendrils unleash a symbiotic Hel Sphere. Upon hit, it pulls nearby enemies toward the impact point and links them, slowing enemies that try to escape.

abilities.name: BLOOD LEECH
abilities.text: Base Effect: Cellular Corrosion new effect: while tethered to enemies, continuously siphon health from every linked target, restoring Venom's Health. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Blade, Venom gains a burst of one-time healing when using certain specific abilities.

abilities.name: ABYSSAL FLAMES
abilities.text: Base Effect: Ignites the symbiote with Phoenix Flames for a duration, replacing Dark Predation with a sweeping Phoenix Touch frontal slash. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, Venom's Phoenix Force is enhanced: every Phoenix Touch applies Sparks. Upon reaching three stacks, the Sparks detonate.

abilities.name: YEOWOO GUSEUL
abilities.text: Fire a Fox Marble forward that bounces off terrain or heroes, then homes in on nearby heroes. It damages enemies, heals allies, and restores Spirit Tail energy

abilities.name: CLAW STRIKE
abilities.text: While Awakened, slash forward with a flurry of attacks

abilities.name: SPECTRAL SURGE
abilities.text: Consume one Spirit Tail to send a spectral fox forward. It heals and grants invulnerability to allies it passes through, damages and Charms enemies, forcing foes to move toward White Fox

abilities.name: FOX FORM AWAKENING
abilities.text: Enter Awakened state, transforming Spirit Tails into physical tails. While active, continuously drain Spirit Tail energy and heal nearby allies. Striking enemies provides additional area healing

abilities.name: SPIRIT SANCTUARY
abilities.text: Teleport to a chosen ally, instantly healing allies in the area while generating a shield

abilities.name: TAIL SWEEP
abilities.text: While Awakened, sweep forward tails to launch up hit enemies

abilities.name: Predatory Pounce
abilities.text: While Awakened, dash forward. Hit an enemy to slow them, enabling a second dash that knocks back enemies

abilities.name: KUMIHO UNLEASHED
abilities.text: Manifest the full Nine-Tailed Fox form and continuously heal nearby allies. Cannot receive healing effects from others while in this form

abilities.name: SPIRIT FOX WARD
abilities.text: White Fox grants Luna Snow a spirit fox for protection. Luna can activate it for a burst of speed and fire it forward, healing allies in its path while applying Charm to enemies

abilities.name: NINE-TAILED AURA
abilities.text: Black Cat shares her luck with her allies. When White Fox embraces her newfound fortune, she unleashestracking Spirit Tails to grant Healing and Speed to allies, while damaging and Slowing foes. When Captain America enjoys his luck, his shield's block radius expands and allows him to aim deflectedProjectiles directly toward his target

abilities.name: NINEFOLD SLAM
abilities.text: In Kumiho Form, slam the ground, causing an explosive shockwave. Hitting enemies or summons grants One-Time Healing to self and nearby allies

abilities.name: BLESSED BY THE NINE
abilities.text: In Kumiho Form, select an ally to grant Continuous Healing, Unstoppable, and Life-Steal for a short time

abilities.name: LUCKY LOAN
abilities.text: Base Effect: White Fox receives an Orb of Life from Black Cat. Upon use, it recovers Spirit Tail energy and converts life energy into Nine-Tailed Aura that shoots out in all directions. This automatically tracks nearby allies and enemies, granting Speed and Healing to allies while damaging and Slowing enemies. nhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Cat, using the Orb triggers a state where Spirit Tail Energy is no longer consumed for a duration, allowing free use of Spectral Surge and Fox Form Awakening.

abilities.name: PSIONIC FOX
abilities.text: Base Effect: Activating Fox Form Awakening no longer consumes Spirit Tail energy, and grants the maximum possible duration immediately upon use. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Psylocke, the cooldown for Fox Form Awakening is drastically reduced.

abilities.name: Roterstern
abilities.text: Fire explosive rounds with his blaster, Roterstern, damaging the target hit and enemies behind them.

abilities.name: Kraken Impact
abilities.text: Leap high, then dash forward and slam down with the bionic arm, dealing damage to enemies in range, marking them for Culling. Marked enemies will perish instantly if their health falls below a certain threshold, recharging the bionic arm for another Kraken Impact within a short period

abilities.name: Trooper's Fist
abilities.text: Dash forward, seizing enemies along the path and launching up enemies at the end of the dash

abilities.name: Tainted Voltage
abilities.text: Charge up and launch a powerful electrical punch with the bionic arm in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies within range and Slowing them. This ability can Knock Down flying heroes

abilities.name: Bionic Hook
abilities.text: Charge up and launch a hook with his bionic arm, reeling in the first target hit and enemies lurking behind

abilities.name: Ceaseless Charge
abilities.text: Roterstern reloads automatically while the bionic arm is in action, granting Bonus Health to the Winter Soldier

abilities.name: Stellar Impact
abilities.text: Inspired by Captain America's resolve, Winter Soldier can leap to the aid of a designated ally, slamming the ground with his mechanical arm to damage nearby foes and grant Bonus Health to allies within range. Captain America and Winter Soldier can interact with each other once both parties confirm. The duo then collides and unleashes a shockwave that damages and slows enemies

abilities.name: TIMELESS VETERANS
abilities.text: Base Effect: Unlocks the Burst Spike ability. Using the bionic arm emits forward electricity, dealing damage and Knocking Back enemies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Punisher, the electric burst applies a Grounded effect and Knocks Back enemies even further.

abilities.name: EXPERT INSTINCT
abilities.text: Base Effect: Securing or participating in a KO grants a stack of Culling Instinct. Each stack reduces the cooldowns of Winter Soldier's other abilities. All stacks are lost upon defeat. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Elsa Bloodstone, the Bonus Health generated by Ceaseless Charge is increased.

abilities.name: Savage Claw
abilities.text: Slash with Adamantium claws for a Claw Strike. Unleashing Feral Leap will enhance it to Berserk Claw Strike for a brief period

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.text: Knock enemies ahead airborne and spiral through the air, sweeping up enemies along the path and delivering a devastating impact at the landing point

abilities.name: Feral Leap
abilities.text: Leap like an animal to snatch the first enemy upon impact and Smash them to the ground. Unleashing this ability will enhance his normal attack to Berserk Claw Strike for a brief period

abilities.name: Undying Animal
abilities.text: Unleash a fierce howl to briefly reduce incoming damage

abilities.name: Vicious Rampage
abilities.text: Dash forward and unleash a Claw Strike

abilities.name: Regenerative Healing Factor
abilities.text: Begin to heal and rise with a hefty Bonus Health, shaking off all debuffs. After a brief moment, any remaining Bonus Health morphs into a one-off heal, zeroing out his Rage. Assists in KOs reduce this cooldown

abilities.name: Berserker Rage
abilities.text: Rage builds when Wolverine attacks or takes hits, boosting the damage of his Claw Strikes and the Bonus Health from his regenerative healing factor

abilities.name: Phoenix Warrior
abilities.text: Wolverine and Hulk can interact with each other. Once both parties confirm, Hulk can lift Wolverine and press the key to hurl him forwardJean Grey imbues Wolverine with the awe-inspiring Phoenix Force. With this power, Wolverine's Feral Leap transforms into Phoenix Warrior. While active, he is enveloped in Phoenix flames that continuously scorch him and nearby enemies, dealing Percentage Damage. In this state, Wolverine's abilities gain Lifesteal when inflicting damage

abilities.name: Kinetic Claws
abilities.text: Cyclops supercharges Wolverine's claws, extending his attack range. While active, Wolverine's Vicious Rampage is replaced with Kinetic Claws, granting him a brief forward lunge that unleashes a flurry of slashes around him

abilities.name: BLAST SLASH
abilities.text: Base Effect: Activation extends the attack range of Savage Claw and Berserk Claw Strike. Vicious Rampage is replaced with Kinetic Claws, granting a brief forward lunge that unleashes a flurry of slashes around. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cyclops, Blast Slash is permanently active.

abilities.name: PAIR OF THREES
abilities.text: Base Effect: Upon activation, Wolverine receives Kinetic Enhancement, gaining increased Movement Speed and a Jump Boost. Attacking enemies applies Kinetic Particles that detonate after a short delay for bonus damage. The effect lasts for duration. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, Wolverine receives Continuous Healing for the entire duration of the ability.
